articles.title: Attackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Internet-Exposed Palo Alto Networks Management Interfaces
articles.text:
Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday warned that threat actors are exploiting the recently patched PHP2Shell vulnerabilities against publicly-accessible management interfaces.
"Active exploitation has been observed targeting the Palo Alto Networks management interface exposed to the internet," the network security company said in an update to its advisory.
The vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS scores: 9.2), allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on systems running affected versions of PHP. The issues were patched upstream by the PHP Foundation on October 21, 2026, in versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35.
The development comes days after Israeli cybersecurity company Dream said it observed a suspected China-nexus threat actor weaponizing the flaws in conjunction with a local privilege escalation bug in the Linux kernel, tracked as Fragnesia (CVE-2026-46300, CVSS score: 7.8), to root 25 servers across the U.S., Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea.
Among those were three systems belonging to a U.S. government-affiliated environment.
"The affected devices run specific versions of a large vendor's firewall software," Dream noted. "The attacker then launched attacks against Active Directory. The recovered artifacts confirm credential extraction and directory enumeration."
Although Dream did not disclose the name of the affected firewall vendor, the timing of the advisory, combined with the fact that other network security companies have not reported malicious exploitation against their products, suggests that these events may be related.
The Hacker News has contacted both Dream and Palo Alto Networks for comment, and we will update the story if we hear back.
The development has prompted the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) to add CVE-2026-46300 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring federal agencies to apply the fixes by October 31, 2026.
"This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP web shells and run commands as root," CISA said.
Palo Alto Networks has also noted that no special configuration is required to be affected by this issue, adding the risk is highest on PAN-OS when access to the management interface is allowed from external IP addresses on the internet.
"This issue strictly affects the management web interface, which includes the HTTPS web UI and XML API service," it said. "It affects the dataplane interface only if a management profile is attached to it."
The following versions of PAN-OS are impacted by PHP2Shell -
- 
    PAN-OS 12.2
    
  - < 12.2.4-h1 (Fixed in >= 12.2.4-h1)
- 
    PAN-OS 12.1
    
  - < 12.1.4-h13 (Fixed in >= 12.1.4-h13) (ETA: 10/29)
  - < 12.1.7-h11 (Fixed in >= 12.1.7-h11)
  - < 12.1.10-h3 (Fixed in >= 12.1.10-h3) (ETA: 10/30)
- 
    PAN-OS 11.2
    
  - < 11.2.4-h23 (Fixed in >= 11.2.4-h23) (ETA: 10/30)
  - < 11.2.7-h23 (Fixed in >= 11.2.7-h23)
  - < 11.2.10-h16 (Fixed in >= 11.2.10-h16)
  - < 11.2.13-h4 (Fixed in >= 11.2.13-h4)
  - < 11.2.16-h1 (Fixed in >= 11.2.16-h1)
- 
    PAN-OS 11.1
    
  - < 11.1.4-h38 (Fixed in >= 11.1.4-h38)
  - < 11.1.6-h40 (Fixed in >= 11.1.6-h40)
  - < 11.1.7-h12 (Fixed in >= 11.1.7-h12) (ETA: 10/30)
  - < 11.1.10-h36 (Fixed in >= 11.1.10-h36)
  - < 11.1.13-h16 (Fixed in >= 11.1.13-h16)
  - < 11.1.16-h4 (Fixed in >= 11.1.16-h4)
- 
    PAN-OS 10.2
    
  - < 10.2.7-h39 (Fixed in >= 10.2.7-h39) (ETA: 10/30)
  - < 10.2.10-h42 (Fixed in >= 10.2.10-h42) (ETA: 10/29)
  - < 10.2.13-h27 (Fixed in >= 10.2.13-h27)
  - < 10.2.16-h12 (Fixed in >= 10.2.16-h12)
  - < 10.2.18-h13 (Fixed in >= 10.2.18-h13)
For PAN-OS versions where fix versions are not yet available, Palo Alto Networks has recommended the following mitigations -
- Route incoming traffic for the MGT port through a DP port, e.g., enabling management profile on a DP interface for management access.
- Replace the Certificate for Inbound Traffic Management.
- Decrypt inbound traffic to the management interface so the firewall can inspect it.
- Enable threat prevention on the inbound traffic to management services.
"Customers with Frontier Virtual Patching (ATP Plus) on PAN-OS 12.2.4 and later versions received advance coverage, released via Threat ID 543004, which was released at 10:21 PM PT on October 20," it said.
"The security risk posed by this issue on PAN-OS and Panorama is minimized by restricting access to the management interface to only trusted internal IP addresses according to our recommended best practice deployment guidelines."
Palo Alto Networks Confirms Dream Report
“We are aware of the report from Dream describing unauthorized exploitation activity targeting internet-facing PAN-OS management interfaces," a spokesperson for Palo Alto Networks told The Hacker News.
“Customers who have applied the available patches are not affected. Furthermore, customers who follow our standard recommendation to not expose the management interface to the public internet are also not affected."
In an update to its threat brief, Palo Alto Networks is recommending customers follow the steps below -
- Immediately remove public internet access to management interfaces if it is enabled.
- Restrict access to trusted internal IP addresses.
- Apply available PAN-OS fixes addressing PHP2Shell.
"Based on data from our Xpanse attack surface management product, only a small fraction of a percent (less than .01%) of our global installed base has internet facing management interfaces configured, and each of these potentially affected customers has been individually contacted by our teams," the spokesperson added. "We will continue to investigate and provide any necessary updates as they become available."
(The story was updated after publication to include a response from Palo Alto Networks.)

articles.title: Intel Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Intel Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
Intel Corporation today reported third-quarter 2026 financial results.
Lip-Bu Tan, Intel CEO"Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology. Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term growth opportunities for our business. Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family, while strengthening our product portfolio and roadmap. We are moving with urgency and focus to capitalize on these opportunities to deliver sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value."
David Zinsner, Intel CFO"We delivered another solid quarter. Revenue, gross margin and earnings per share exceeded guidance, including our strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years. Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities across our broader portfolio, and we will continue making disciplined investments in capacity and working capital to increase supply and support future growth."
Business Highlights
Company Momentum
- Completed a $23 billion public equity offering to support future growth opportunities while maintaining a strong balance sheet and investment-grade rating.
- Announced plans to acquire Classiq, combining its quantum software synthesis platform with Intel's spin-qubit manufacturing and software expertise to create a full-stack quantum computing platform.
Product Momentum
- Announced plans for a multiyear collaboration with Oracle intended to expand Intel Xeon -based computing on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), which is expected to span current and future Intel Xeon platforms, including planned OCI X14 offerings powered by Intel's next-generation server processor code-named Diamond Rapids.
- Shared new technical details on the Intel GPU D-series, formerly code-named Crescent Island, introduced new Intel Xeon-based rack designs and highlighted open software and ecosystem innovations at OCP Global Summit 2026. Intel also demonstrated day-0 support for Meta's Muse Spark Open, which has been tested and is running on the upcoming Intel GPU D-series and Intel Xeon platforms.
- Showcased three architectures for Agentic AI and Enterprise-scale workloads at Hot Chips 2026: next-generation Intel Xeon code-named Diamond Rapids for high-performance orchestration, Intel GPU D-series for efficient inference, and Intel Core Series 3 for intelligent client and edge computing.
- Announced the first Googlebook devices powered by Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors with premium devices from Acer, ASUS and Lenovo, bringing together Google's next-generation computing and Intel's flagship client platform.
- Collaborated with AMD to bring x86 CPU optimizations for PyTorch together in oneDNN, simplifying AI development and deployment across Intel and AMD CPUs.
- Announced a collaboration with SAP to bridge business IT systems and the operational technology that controls physical equipment and processes through Physical AI.
Foundry Momentum
- Released Intel 14A 0.9 process design kit (PDK) in October.
- Announced a collaboration with Lens Technology, combining Intel's advanced packaging expertise with Lens Technology's precision glass processing capabilities to enable advanced semiconductor packaging for the AI era.
- Completed the RAMP-C program, enabling validated prototypes, ecosystem readiness and early customer engagement to accelerate momentum for Secure Enclave.
- Announced a collaboration with ASML to accelerate industry readiness for High-NA EUV manufacturing.
- Collaborated with Lam Research and Applied Materials on new facilities to expand capacity and enable joint R&D in process technology and manufacturing equipment.
Culture & Leadership
- Appointed Dean Jarnac as executive vice president and chief sales officer, leading Intel's global sales organization and strengthening customer relationships and go-to-market execution across the company's product portfolio.

articles.title: I can't stop looking at the touchscreen MacBook Pro display, and now I know why — it's a tech unicorn
articles.text:
I can't stop looking at the touchscreen MacBook Pro display, and now I know why — it's a tech unicorn
A fab the size of the Colosseum
Now that I've seen and touched the touchscreen MacBook Pro, I'm starting to understand that, despite the invention of a Frankenstein-ed new display term ('PROLED'?), this display might be something special. It looks extraordinary, and when compared visually with, say, the Lenovo Yoga Pro 9i Aura Edition, which also has a Tandem OLED, it doesn't even seem to be of the same species.
There are good reasons for this, which span from the fabrication process to the core specs of what is clearly Apple's most advanced laptop display yet.
Starting with manufacturing, Apple says it employed an unnamed manufacturing partner to build these panels in what's known as a Gen-8 OLED Fab. Seeing as there are just four of these cutting-edge facilities in the world, and that one of them is operated by Samsung Display, which has reportedly partnered with Apple on display tech previously, I'd guess it's Samsung.
One of the most notable features of these manufacturing facilities is their massive size. Whoever the partner is, we know that the touchscreen MacBook Pro's panels are being manufactured in a chamber around the size of the Colosseum in Rome. These huge facilities improve yield, efficiency, and costs.
Though less than a millimeter thick, the laptop PROLED XDR panel is comprised of 50 layers. Even what appear to be individual panels have many layers, sometimes just a nanometer thick. The two stacks of OLED have, for instance, 30 layers, though the organic self-emissive material is layered onto the panels and dried, making the layers range from one nanometer to hundreds of nanometers thick. FWIW, I held some of these individual panels, and they are incredibly thin and light.
Behind the OLED is the TFT (thin-film transistor) glass substrate that powers and drives the imagery on the surface.
What's not mentioned here is the digitizing layer (basically the same touch technology you find on the iPhone and iPad) that drives touch; that's because it's integrated with the whole in a process that, if it isn't already, probably should be patented.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Despite working with a third party, the production is another Apple trademark bespoke process, and one not necessarily replicated in other Tandem OLED or even basic OLED display manufacturing processes.
The specs bear that out. Where the Lenovo Yoga Pro 9i Aura Edition touch display has a pleasing 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro boasts 10,000,000:1. In person, and even under bright lighting conditions, the blacks and definition I saw on the touchscreen MacBook Pro PROLED XDR are stunning.
The MacBook Pro display also looks better because Apple equipped it with up to 2,000 nits for HDR and SDR content, and both an anti-reflective screen and the option of the nano-etched one, as well. Essentially, I could see myself reflected in the Lenovo, and could not detect my reflection in the MacBook Pro.
Also, for those concerned about fingerprints collecting on the touchscreen MacBook Pro, Apple has applied an oleophobic coating to the standard and etched displays. In my hands-on time with several of the new laptops, I didn't notice any significant fingerprints.
Compared to the Lenovo Yoga Pro 9i's 1,600 nits, the touchscreen MacBook Pro looks better equipped for working in direct sunlight. Based on what I saw, the MacBook Pro also maintains much better off-axis color quality.
Looking beyond direct visual comparisons with pro-grade Windows laptops, Apple is positioning the touchscreen MacBook Pro display as both a color reference screen and one that has grayscale precision reportedly sufficient for medical diagnostics. This is basically a reference monitor on a laptop frame.
So, sure, the story is that we finally have a touchscreen MacBook, but it may be the visual quality that ultimately wins over creative, business, medical, and film professionals. It's probably the best display Apple has ever produced, not just for a laptop, but possibly for any Mac system.
Of course, a screen panel alone does not make a laptop, and there are questions around whether everyone wants or needs touch, if the redesigned hinge is stable enough to keep the laptop from wobbling with every touch — and if touch capability is worth the almost $1,000 premium.

articles.title: Neuralink logra que una persona se comunique por teléfono mediante señales cerebrales
articles.text:
Neuralink, la empresa de interfaces cerebro-computadora fundada por Elon Musk, demostró que una persona logre mantener una llamada telefónica mediante el uso exclusivo de su actividad cerebral.
El implante capta las señales neuronales asociadas con el habla que la persona intenta producir, las envía a una computadora conectada al teléfono y esta decodifica esas señales en palabras, que luego se transmiten como voz sintetizada a través del micrófono del dispositivo hacia el interlocutor.
La prueba se realizó con un participante del estudio clínico VOICE, un programa de Neuralink orientado a restaurar la comunicación en personas que perdieron la capacidad de hablar. Durante la demostración, el usuario conversó por teléfono con su esposa; según la empresa, la pareja había iniciado su relación justamente a través de llamadas telefónicas, lo que le dio un valor particular al ensayo.
Cómo funciona la decodificación del habla imaginada
El sistema de Neuralink traduce señales neuronales vinculadas a la intención de hablar en palabras concretas. Hasta ahora, los usuarios debían presionar un botón para iniciar y detener la grabación de esa actividad cerebral destinada a la decodificación del habla.
La compañía presentó un nuevo sistema de detección automática de actividad vocal neuronal, capaz de reconocer cuándo el participante intenta hablar sin necesidad de un control manual. Esto podría reducir la dependencia de controles físicos y facilitar la comunicación en personas con limitaciones graves de movimiento.
Neuralink también incorporó visualizaciones en tiempo real que muestran la intensidad y distribución de las señales neuronales registradas por el implante. Estas herramientas permiten a los participantes probar distintos patrones de habla imaginada e identificar cuáles generan una actividad neuronal más fuerte, con el objetivo de mejorar el desempeño del decodificador.
Un agente de inteligencia artificial activado con el pensamiento
Entre las nuevas funciones, Neuralink incluyó la posibilidad de activar un agente de Grok mediante la frase imaginada “Hey Neuralink”, seguida de una orden. Una vez activado, el agente ejecuta la tarea solicitada de manera autónoma en una computadora.
La empresa describió esta integración como una demostración temprana de cómo las interfaces cerebro-computadora podrían habilitar una interacción más directa con sistemas impulsados por inteligencia artificial.
Dictado de texto y mejoras en la aplicación Bloom
Neuralink probó, además, la integración del dictado cerebral en aplicaciones de iPhone, lo que permite a los usuarios ingresar texto sin recurrir a los teclados convencionales. La función está orientada a reducir las dificultades que enfrentan personas con esclerosis lateral amiotrófica (ELA) al utilizar teclados tradicionales o sistemas de dictado por voz.
La compañía también evaluó mejoras en Bloom, su aplicación móvil para comunicación basada en interfaces cerebro-computadora. Entre ellas, un sistema de edición más veloz para corregir texto mal decodificado y una función que permite la comunicación por voz sin necesidad de desbloquear previamente el teléfono.
Un desarrollo nacido de una prueba intensiva de 72 horas
Estas mejoras se desarrollaron durante una jornada de trabajo de 72 horas en el domicilio de un participante del estudio VOICE, donde ingenieros de Neuralink trabajaron junto al usuario y su esposa. El equipo construyó y probó prototipos en tiempo real, con ajustes basados en la retroalimentación directa del participante. Algunas de esas funciones continuaron su desarrollo en las semanas posteriores a la prueba.
Las demostraciones reflejan el esfuerzo de Neuralink por llevar la comunicación controlada por el cerebro más allá del entorno de laboratorio hacia actividades cotidianas. No obstante, la empresa no entregó resultados cuantitativos sobre el desempeño de las nuevas funciones, como la precisión en la decodificación del habla o los tiempos de respuesta del sistema.
Los implantes cerebrales de Neuralink permanecen en etapa experimental y no cuentan con la aprobación de la Administración de Alimentos y Medicamentos de Estados Unidos (FDA) ni de otras autoridades regulatorias.

articles.title: Xbox : les ventes en baisse de 14%, mais la demande dépasserait l’offre selon sa PDG Asha Sharma
articles.text:
Alors que les ventes de consoles Xbox continuent de baisser, la patronne de Microsoft Gaming se veut positive, en indiquant que « la demande dépasse les stocks disponibles ».
Depuis plusieurs trimestres, les résultats de Xbox témoignent des difficultés rencontrées par Microsoft sur le marché des consoles. Au dernier trimestre fiscal publié, le chiffre d’affaires concernant le hardware Xbox a encore reculé de 14% sur un an (Microsoft se refusant toujours à dévoiler le moindre chiffre de ventes).
Une tendance qui illustre les difficultés persistantes de la division jeux vidéo de Microsoft, désormais tournée vers la prochaine génération de consoles, incarnée par Project Helix.
Des Xbox qui se vendent de moins en moins
Dans ce contexte, Asha Sharma, la patronne de Xbox, se veut néanmoins positive. Dans un message publié sur le réseau X, relayé par Kotaku, elle explique que Microsoft ne parvient pas à fabriquer autant de consoles que les joueurs souhaitent en acheter. La dirigeante pointe notamment la flambée du coût des composants, qui complique la production des machines.
« Les ventes de consoles restent limitées par l’offre, la demande étant supérieure au nombre de consoles disponibles » indique Asha Sharma. Difficile, dès lors, de résumer la situation à un simple manque d’intérêt pour les consoles Xbox. Mais cette explication mérite tout de même d’être confrontée à une certaine réalité du marché.
Xbox en rupture de stock… Mais pas partout
La Xbox Series X (sous toutes ses formes) est effectivement affichée comme indisponible sur le Microsoft Store, aux États-Unis comme en France. Pour autant, il ne faut pas en conclure que la machine est introuvable.
La console reste disponible auprès de nombreuses enseignes, spécialisées ou non, aux États-Unis. En France, des enseignes comme Micromania ou la Fnac proposent actuellement la console de Microsoft, sans aucune difficulté apparente.
La situation peut varier d’un distributeur à l’autre, mais une rupture sur la boutique officielle ne signifie pas nécessairement que toute l’offre est épuisée.
Mais sans données précises sur les commandes, les stocks ou encore les volumes de production, il reste bien difficile de vérifier l’affirmation de la dirigeante.
A 800 euros (et privée de nombreuses exclusivités), la Xbox Series X a-t-elle encore les arguments pour convaincre ?
Au-delà des stocks, Microsoft doit aussi composer avec un problème autrement plus délicat, à savoir l’attractivité de ses consoles Xbox Series. En novembre 2020, la Xbox Series X était commercialisée à 499 euros. Aujourd’hui, son prix officiel atteint 799,99 euros, soit une hausse de 300 euros en près de quatre ans. Une augmentation impossible à ignorer au moment de choisir une nouvelle console.
Pendant plusieurs années, Microsoft a progressivement ouvert son catalogue en portant certains de ses jeux exclusifs sur PlayStation 5. De quoi brouiller un peu plus les pistes pour les joueurs tentés par une Xbox.
Alors oui, la PS5 a elle aussi vu son prix grimper, passant de 499 euros à son lancement à 649 euros aujourd’hui. Mais pour 150 euros de moins que la Xbox Series X, elle donne accès aux exclusivités PlayStation, tout en permettant de profiter de certains jeux autrefois associés à l’écosystème Xbox, comme Halo Campaign Evolved, Forza Horizon, Sea of Thieves…
Asha Sharma a depuis annoncé un retour à davantage d’exclusivités (c’est le cas de l’excellent Gears of War E-Day, que l’on vous conseille vivement), mais les changements successifs de stratégie (et de prix) auront bien du mal à dissiper les doutes sur cette génération.
En attendant, Microsoft indique vouloir développer son programme de consoles reconditionnées afin d’étoffer les stocks disponibles à l’approche des fêtes de fin d’année 2026 et de la sortie très attendue d’un certain GTA 6.

articles.title: Motherboard and GPU Prices Could Rise Further as PCB Shortages Extend to 2030
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Motherboard and GPU Prices Could Rise Further as PCB Shortages Extend to 2030
Printed circuit boards (PCBs) are the foundation of every PC component, as they mount everything and connect the entire system using electrical components, wiring, and more. However, we are about to enter another phase of consumer electronics price hikes, as these PCBs are now experiencing severe component shortages projected to last until 2030. According to Nikkei Asia, an unnamed executive from an American PC maker told the publication that PCB manufacturers are confirming this situation, with some predicting that orders placed today may not be fulfilled until late 2028.
American PC Maker for Nikkei AsiaEven though PC shipments could decline again next year, we are still struggling to secure enough PCB supplies to meet our needs.
Currently, ordering some PCB designs can take 30 months to fulfill, so PC makers are about to face new challenges in managing the supply chain. AI servers are being blamed, as they require multiple layers of PCB material, large amounts of copper, and the specialized fiberglass used in PCB construction. NVIDIA recently initiated several partnerships with major chip substrate makers, which produce small PCBs that silicon dies are mounted on. Since PCB manufacturers have been caught up in the AI buildout phase, some Taiwanese PC makers note that the price of copper-clad laminates (CCLs) used in PCB construction has increased 12 times since July of this year. The combination of AI server demand consuming all the PCB manufacturing capacity and rising material costs will lead to another round of price hikes across the PC ecosystem.
Sources:
				Nikkei Asia, 				via Tom's Hardware

Excellent en tout, mais passant après un Galaxy S25 Ultra au niveau presque équivalent en tous points, il justifie réellement son existence par cet écran novateur qui, à nos yeux, le sauve de l'écueil de la redite absolue.

articles.title: Saab completes secret sea trials for its new autonomous underwater vehicle
articles.text:
Saab unveils its monster underwater drone vehicle, created and built in less than a year
Sweden's new underwater drone has cleared its first sea trials
- Saab develops a working underwater drone demonstrator in less than a year
- Sweden's new underwater vehicle has completed its initial sea trials
- Military authorities will evaluate the drone before deciding on procurement use
Saab has built a large uncrewed underwater vehicle demonstrator, known as LUUV, in collaboration with Swedish defense authorities.
The company finished development in less than a year after receiving its contract, and the prototype has already passed its first sea trials successfully.
This means the drone now counts as a working demonstrator, giving engineers a real platform they can test and improve in the water.
Quick progress and real-world testing
The Swedish Defence Materiel Administration (FMV) and the Swedish Armed Forces are also involved, and they will help judge whether the technology suits military needs.
Saab says the fast progress came from officials and engineers working side by side to develop and test the equipment in a short period.
“This project demonstrates how new technologies can be rapidly translated into practical operational value,” said Mats Wicksell, head of Saab’s business area Naval.
“The fact that we have also been able to develop and test the system in such a short timeframe demonstrates the strength of the collaboration between the Swedish Armed Forces, FMV and Saab.”
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Saab argues this kind of partnership can shorten the time between spotting a military requirement and testing a practical solution at sea.
The completed sea trials offer a first look at how the vehicle performs in actual ocean conditions, rather than only during development testing.
A demonstrator is an early working model built to prove that an idea functions, rather than a finished product ready for regular service.
However, this milestone applies only to a demonstrator, so further development is still needed before the system can be considered ready for operational use.
Going forward, Saab expects the next phase to bring more autonomous functions, software improvements and additional sensors.
Software, benefits, and open questions
The project relies on Saab's Autonomous Ocean Core, a proprietary software platform designed to let underwater and surface vessels operate autonomously without constant human control.
This software-focused approach lets developers build automated functions into marine platforms and adjust them later as operational requirements change over time.
Saab believes uncrewed underwater vehicles could extend mission endurance, improve awareness of activity beneath the surface and strengthen a navy's overall capabilities under the sea.
Such platforms could prove useful for maritime surveillance and other underwater missions, although Saab has not shared the full specifications of this particular demonstrator.
The company has not announced the vehicle's size, maximum depth, endurance, speed or payload capacity, so many important details remain unknown for now.
The next development phase will therefore be important, because it should show which capabilities the platform can actually deliver to the armed forces.
Swedish authorities will, however, use these results to decide whether the technology deserves more investment.
Whatever happens next, Saab has shown that close collaboration between industry and government can deliver a working underwater vehicle in a remarkably short time.
Via Drone Front

articles.title: Reddit pasará a exigir inicio de sesión tras perder más de un millón de visitas semanales desde buscadores
articles.text:
Reddit anunció que pasará a ser una plataforma pensada para usuarios con sesión iniciada, después de que el tráfico que recibe desde buscadores cayera en más de un millón de visitas semanales en promedio durante octubre. La empresa lo comunicó el 29 de octubre junto con los resultados del tercer trimestre.
El director ejecutivo y cofundador, Steve Huffman, escribió en una publicación en el sitio que la decisión es “la correcta” para la plataforma y para el negocio. Reconoció además que, para alguien cuya vida estuvo definida por la internet abierta, se trata de un cambio grande.
El cambio no será inmediato. Según TechCrunch, Reddit hará pruebas en mercados seleccionados fuera de Estados Unidos durante el cuarto trimestre y todavía no tiene un calendario para extenderlo a todos sus usuarios. La empresa también admitió que el acceso a una portada sin cuenta sigue siendo importante.
Reddit aclaró que iniciar sesión no implica renunciar al anonimato ni eliminará la opción de navegar de forma anónima, mediante un modo incógnito que está siendo reconstruido. Huffman reconoció que quedan preguntas abiertas sobre dónde deben trazarse los límites entre la experiencia con cuenta y sin ella.
Los usuarios en Estados Unidos bajan mientras los ingresos suben
Los usuarios activos diarios en todo el mundo se mantuvieron estables frente al trimestre anterior, en 130,3 millones. En Estados Unidos, el mercado más grande de la plataforma, pasaron de 53,2 millones en el segundo trimestre a 50,7 millones en el tercero, un 2% menos que un año antes.
Reddit advirtió que, si la tendencia continúa, sus usuarios diarios podrían caer a un porcentaje bajo de dos dígitos el próximo trimestre. TechCrunch calculó que una baja de entre el 10% y el 12% llevaría la cifra a entre 115 y 117 millones.
Huffman dijo a CNBC que la reducción del tráfico de referencia desde Google tuvo un peso central en la decisión de exigir sesión iniciada. Afirmó que ese tráfico cayó de forma notable en el trimestre y que la tendencia seguirá en el cuarto.
El negocio, en cambio, creció. Los ingresos aumentaron un 53% frente al mismo período del año anterior, hasta USD 895 millones, por encima de los cerca de USD 875 millones que esperaba Wall Street. La ganancia neta subió un 74%, hasta USD 283 millones.
Los ingresos por publicidad crecieron un 54%, hasta USD 847 millones. Los demás, que incluyen la venta de datos a empresas de IA, avanzaron un 35%, hasta USD 48 millones. En Estados Unidos, el ingreso promedio por usuario diario subió un 53%, hasta USD 13,82.
Datos propios, anuncios más precisos y licencias a empresas de IA
TechCrunch señaló que la medida busca proteger los contenidos de Reddit del rastreo automático de las empresas de IA y así reforzar los acuerdos de licencia con los desarrolladores de modelos. Esos contratos permiten a las compañías usar las conversaciones de la plataforma bajo pago.
Los usuarios con cuenta, a diferencia de los que llegan por buscadores, aportan más información sobre sus intereses y su comportamiento. Eso permite orientar mejor la publicidad y personalizar el contenido, y por eso valen más para los anunciantes, según TechCrunch.
Un día antes, Reddit había presentado un canal de recomendaciones llamado “Para ti”, que combina publicaciones de las comunidades a las que pertenece cada persona con sugerencias basadas en sus intereses. La empresa planea empujar esa función entre los usuarios con sesión iniciada.
Las primeras pruebas del modelo con sesión iniciada comenzarán en el cuarto trimestre, en mercados seleccionados fuera de Estados Unidos, según la empresa.

articles.title: PSA: Fake KytyPS5 and AnyPS5 Repos on GitHub Are Spreading Malware
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
PSA: Fake KytyPS5 and AnyPS5 Repos on GitHub Are Spreading Malware
Fake GitHub repositories posing as two PS5 projects, the KytyPS5 emulator and the AnyPS5 porting tool, are being used to spread password-stealing malware, according to NordVPN's Threat Intelligence team. As reported by Tom's Hardware, visitors get pointed to a ZIP file whose Windows executable unpacks a hidden multi-stage loader. The loader first checks whether it's on a real gaming PC, and exits if the system has less than 2 GB of RAM or no physical GPU, or looks like a virtual machine or cloud server. It seems built to dodge sandboxes and security researchers. Here's how NordVPN CTO Marijus Briedis put it:
Emulation fans are a perfect target. They are used to downloading experimental software from GitHub and running unsigned files, so nothing about this feels suspicious. But this is not an emulator. It steals your data, hides from your antivirus and erases its own tracks before you notice anything is wrong.
On a machine that passes the aforementioned checks, the malware adds Microsoft Defender exclusion rules, then decrypts and runs a packed payload that NordVPN believes is an infostealer. A cleanup script wipes the files about two minutes later. Its self-signed certificates carry fake company names and were created the same day the malware was built, so the campaign may be automated. 
Interest in PS5 emulation has climbed since Sony started stepping back from PC ports of its single-player games, and KytyPS5 has already run the PS5 version of GTA 5 at up to 60 FPS, so the bait is well chosen. The Defender trick has shown up before too, in a fake "leaked" GTA 6 build. Readers are advised to confirm a repository belongs to the project's developers, check creation dates, and avoid third-party download links. Anyone who ran one of these files should disconnect, run a full scan, and change passwords using another device.
Sources:
				NordVPN, 				Tom's Hardware, 				Engadget

articles.title: Utiliza Gemini de Google para conseguir trabajo: ingresa este prompt en la IA para mejorar la hoja de vida
articles.text:
Si estás buscando trabajo o tratando de optimizar tus postulaciones, puedes acudir a Gemini de Google para revisar tu currículum u hoja de vida.
Google compartió este prompt o indicación para ingresar en su inteligencia artificial y recibir recomendaciones de mejora después de describir experiencias laborales anteriores:
“Actúa como un redactor profesional de currículums. Usa mis notas originales y sin editar sobre mi trabajo anterior y conviértelas en cuatro puntos clave de alto impacto para un puesto de ___. Comienza cada punto con un verbo de acción contundente. Mantén un tono ejecutivo, claro y optimizado para sistemas de seguimiento de candidatos (ATS)”.
Utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial para mejorar un currículum puede ser útil, ya que permiten ordenar ideas, identificar logros relevantes, corregir errores de redacción y adaptar la presentación de una experiencia laboral a los requisitos de un puesto.
Estas plataformas también pueden sugerir verbos de acción, detectar frases poco claras y ayudar a estructurar un perfil profesional más atractivo para los sistemas de seguimiento de candidatos.
Sin embargo, es clave usarlas con precaución. Antes de copiar información en un chatbot, conviene eliminar o modificar cualquier dato confidencial.
Esto incluye números de documento, direcciones, teléfonos personales, correos electrónicos privados, contraseñas, salarios, datos bancarios, contratos, nombres de clientes o detalles internos de empresas donde se trabajó.
La recomendación es compartir solo la información necesaria para recibir una sugerencia útil. Por ejemplo, se puede describir una tarea realizada, un objetivo alcanzado o una habilidad adquirida sin revelar cifras sensibles ni información que esté protegida por acuerdos de confidencialidad.
La inteligencia artificial puede servir como apoyo para redactar mejor, pero la revisión final debe quedar siempre en manos de la persona. Proteger la privacidad y verificar cada recomendación es tan importante como presentar un currículum claro, preciso y adecuado para la búsqueda laboral.
Google presenta Gemini 4 Carbon
Google presentó Gemini 4 Carbon, un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial orientado a tareas complejas de ciberseguridad.
La compañía aseguró que lidera el índice de Artificial Analysis con 59 puntos y que obtuvo los mejores resultados en 15 de 17 pruebas comparativas, aunque por ahora no estará disponible para desarrolladores, empresas ni usuarios particulares.
El acceso inicial quedará limitado a especialistas en seguridad informática seleccionados por Google.
La empresa indicó que esta semana dará acceso a “un subconjunto de defensores cibernéticos” y que luego ampliará el uso de manera gradual a socios de confianza a través del Programa Fairwind, que reúne a más de 650 socios. No hay una fecha confirmada para su llegada al público general.
Según los datos difundidos por Google, Carbon alcanzó 88,2% en SEC-bench Pro, una prueba que mide la capacidad de detectar fallas en programas reales; 54,8% en ExploitGym, centrada en la explotación de vulnerabilidades, y 71,0% en CWE-bench, que evalúa si puede corregirlas.
Sin embargo, estas mediciones se realizaron sin las salvaguardas que acompañarán al modelo cuando se comercialice, por lo que los resultados podrían variar en su uso final.
Google no publicó un informe técnico ni informó la cantidad de parámetros de Carbon.
Además, las evaluaciones independientes citadas por VentureBeat señalaron que el modelo mejora frente a Argon en programación y trabajo con conocimiento, pero todavía queda detrás de algunos competidores en tareas profesionales, ingeniería de software y uso de computadoras. Registró más alucinaciones que Argon en una prueba de datos factuales.
Cuando esté disponible para desarrolladores, Carbon tendrá un precio inicial de USD 2 por cada millón de tokens de entrada y USD 10 por cada millón de salida. Más adelante, esas tarifas subirán a USD 4 y USD 20, aunque Google no precisó cuándo finalizará el período introductorio.

articles.title: Stop the press: AirPods Max 2 are my Headphones of the Year, ending Bowers & Wilkins' long run of form — here's why
articles.text:
AirPods Max 2 are my Headphones of the Year Award despite their few clear flaws — because when you do everything else this well, it just doesn't matter
That ANC! That sound quality!
I did not expect to love the AirPods Max 2 so much, upon testing them. Nobody is more surprised than me that I chose Apple's new over-ears for Headphones of the Year at the TechRadar Product of the Year Awards 2026.
Bowers & Wilkins has won this award the last few years, and I even hovered over the excellent five-star HEDD HEDDPhones D1 for a moment. But despite being trailblazing cans from a pioneering new audio outfit (and for some, that will fit the bill perfectly) the D1 are open-back, wired, passive beasts. And the thing is, AirPods Max 2 just do so much more for the money.
Even though you, the readers, also voted the AirPods Max 2 for this award in our TechRadar Readers' Choice Awards 2026, I'm certain there will still be some cries of discontentment about this. 'Wait, so Apple's AirPods Max 2, the set that look almost identical to the 2020 originals, and have lower battery life than any of the competition, and have no wireless hi-res codecs (and the wired lossless support also came to first-gen model anyway), and that still come with the weird headphone bra case, those won?'
Yes. Yes really. And if you give me a few minutes, I'm going to explain why. That said, if you still want to comment below, I'm all ears.
Yes, AirPods Max 2 look similar to their 7-year-old siblings — they're just that good
OK, so the lossless stuff with a wired connection isn't new, and neither is the look of the things. But what has changed with these March 2026 issue cans is the inclusion of a new H2 chip and all of its computational wizardry. And this makes them punchier sonically, ups the ANC efficacy significantly (and it wasn't at all bad beforehand, remember), and adds new perks such as Live Translation, Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness, Head Gesture control and the Camera Remote feature.
The one caveat is that some features require an iPhone 15 Pro or newer. Android owner? This isn't your day I'm afraid, and I'm sorry about that — your closest pick would be last September's Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (Gen 2).
But the box-fresh Apple Intelligence features genuinely make for an excellent, full-throttle music and call-handling experience that does everything you need and does it with minimal fuss, app consultations, screen taps or button pushing.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
For me, the right way to go about Apple's incredible implementation of ANC here is to deploy both noise cancellation and the Conversation Awareness toggle, which you'll find with a tap of the AirPods Max bubble near the top of the settings tab on your iPhone, or by swiping down from the top-right of your screen, to get the Control Center.
What it means is that by default, you will not be interrupted, but when you speak up, music is automatically lowered and external noises are piped in as you need them. And I'm mentioning this specifically because so many rival headphones aim to offer this (ie. a cocoon of silence as a backdrop for your music, but with a decent bit of software that kicks in when you speak to take it all away and pipe ambient sound in) and don't get anywhere near achieving what Apple has done.
OK so it's not groundbreaking. But it is so, so good in your everyday work life — I implore you to try it, if you get the chance.
That said, if you take just one thing away from this particular feature let it be that the claim in the marketing release is true: the noise-cancellation in AirPods Max 2 really is 1.5 times better than before. It's outstanding.
These headphones are almost deviously, head-shakingly good at isolating and melting away the noise from my surroundings, but without the wind-tunnel effect or pressure sensation I have occasionally found disconcerting or nauseating in other cans — the handful that offer ANC anywhere near this effective, at any rate.
I maintain that for emotive music or movies using Apple's special (and decidedly specific) brand of head-tracked Spatial Audio with a backdrop of near-silence wherever I tested them, Apple's AirPods Max 2 went straight to the top of a big pile.
Did I mention how comfortable they are? So many headphones start to dig in across the top of my head. That never happens with Apple's slightly odd-looking but delightfully nonrestrictive mesh headband.
Simply put, they're the headphones I started reaching for on the daily since I acquired them in March of this year, and they're still the set I reach for now. I didn't think this would happen, but it would be wrong of me to deny it, all the same.
Despite several other new releases resting on my desk at any given moment, it's the AirPods Max 2 I always go for when the working day is done. And I was taught a long time ago that this can only mean they're the best product you've currently got — we cannot argue with our own subliminal preference. I mean, that is as long as they haven't run out of battery…

Becky became Audio Editor at TechRadar in 2024, but joined the team in 2022 as Senior Staff Writer, focusing on all things hi-fi. Before this, she spent three years at What Hi-Fi? testing and reviewing everything from wallet-friendly wireless earbuds to huge high-end sound systems. Prior to gaining her MA in Journalism in 2018, Becky freelanced as an arts critic alongside a 22-year career as a professional dancer and aerialist – any love of dance starts with a love of music. Becky has previously contributed to Stuff, FourFourTwo and The Stage. When not writing, she can still be found throwing shapes in a dance studio, these days with varying degrees of success.

articles.title: Solidigm Considers $45 Billion Investment in U.S. NAND Flash Manufacturing
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Solidigm Considers $45 Billion Investment in U.S. NAND Flash Manufacturing
Late last month, we learned that SK hynix-owned NAND Flash maker Solidigm has been considering expanding its manufacturing business to the United States. According to Bloomberg, the company is contemplating a massive $45 billion investment. However, before deciding on that, Solidigm aims to get approval from the U.S. government to send equipment to its fabs in Dalian, China, so it can continue funding expansion in the United States. As a reminder, obtaining some chipmaking equipment in China requires U.S. government approval, meaning the company is putting things on hold pending regulatory approval.
Currently, Solidigm operates Fab 1 in Dalian, China, and has accelerated the construction of Fab 2 nearby. This expansion aims to increase production by 50% by 2027 to meet the rising demand for NAND Flash. Solidigm owns and operates this facility, marking a resumption of expansion in mainland China after a four-year project freeze. At present, Solidigm produces about 100,000 wafers per month of NAND Flash, so a 50% increase by 2027 would boost production to approximately 150,000 wafers per month.Solidigm will also begin producing its floating gate 3D QLC NAND Flash, which will feature over 200 active storage layers per chip. This advancement will enable multi-terabyte SSDs for enterprise use, which is currently the primary market for these solutions. While QLC NAND Flash is slower than the typical TLC variant and has less endurance, AI workloads are demanding more capacity at higher densities. Adding a $45 billion expansion in the U.S. would help Solidigm capitalize on the massive industry shortages driven by AI demand and would help the U.S. secure domestic production, even when operated by a third-party company.

articles.title: Report claims AI is recommending risky security moves — so maybe you shouldn't hand over full control of your systems just yet
articles.text:
Report claims AI is recommending risky security moves — so maybe you shouldn't hand over full control of your systems just yet
Human decisions are being made by AI
- Report says AI is being given too much authority and autonomy to handle business-critical security decisions
- 70% of organizations delegate decisions to AI that would have been made by a human 12 months ago
- A “control gap” exists between the authority given to AI and an organization’s ability to audit it
Delegating complicated decisions to AI is leading organizations to place relatively new technology in charge of user permissions, in control of sensitive data, and risk security issues, new research has claimed.
A study by Illumio looked into how organizations are handing decision recently performed by humans to AI, without apparently taking into account the potential for serious issues to arise.
It found the majority (70%) of organizations are delegating previously human-made decisions to AI, but only around half (49%) can see what action is taken by an AI agent an audit it.
AI recommendations
The nature of AI agents makes this a particularly risky strategy, and the research has found that an incredible 56% of organizations are willing to accept greater cyber risks than 12 months ago. Almost half of that group (47%) have admitted to permitting AI actions in production environments.
Allowing AI agents to have free run of enterprise data, applications, and infrastructure is leading to wholly avoidable situations. Illumio’s research found that a control gap between the rules that organizations believe AI agents are operating within and what the technology is actually capable of.
Some 76% of organizations have experienced one or more security issues thanks to AI in the past year, with 35% revealing that following AI recommendations would result in a security risk. Meanwhile, 26% reported AI agents or tools had connected to other systems without the necessary approval.
More worrying is the 24% of organizations reporting AI’s drive to access data it shouldn’t be able to see, and another 24% stating it has triggered (or produced) an unauthorized action.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Strict limits
Of course, AI is already used within cybersecurity, and has proved successful with multiple vendors rolling out AI-enhanced solutions. But while 67% of organizations are using AI cybersecurity tools, 32% let AI conduct investigations without human oversight and 29% permit the software to deploy code changes completely unsupervised.
“The biggest AI risk may not be a system that breaks its rules. It may be one that was never given meaningful limits in the first place," noted Raghu Nandakumara, VP of Industry Strategy at Illumio.
Unleashing AI agents without constraints has left businesses struggling to control the software.
As Nandakumara observes, AI agents are persistent, and attempting to outwit their next move is pointless. Instead, “businesses must set strict limits on what they can access and do, then enforce those limits within the application and across the underlying infrastructure. That is how you contain unexpected behavior before it causes real damage.”

articles.title: Las centrales de gas para centros de datos borrarían 15 años de reducción de emisiones de CO2 en Estados Unidos
articles.text:
Las emisiones de dióxido de carbono del sector eléctrico de Estados Unidos podrían subir 42% hasta 2030 si se construyen las centrales de gas que las empresas tecnológicas planean para alimentar sus centros de datos de IA. Eso borraría 15 años de reducciones, según un análisis interno del Sierra Club, organización ambientalista estadounidense.
El cálculo, que publicó Bloomberg el 28 de octubre, estima que la generación eléctrica del país emitiría 2.100 millones de toneladas de CO2 en 2030. Son 618 millones de toneladas más que en 2025. The Verge añadió que ese aumento equivale a la electricidad que consumen más de 128 millones de hogares en un año.
La mayor parte del incremento no pasaría por la red convencional. Más de 460 millones de toneladas vendrían de plantas que las tecnológicas construyen por su cuenta, fuera de la red, para no esperar la conexión. Jeremy Fisher, asesor principal de clima y energía del Sierra Club, dijo que esa cifra equivale a las emisiones anuales de México.
Las centrales conectadas a la red sumarían otras 154 millones de toneladas, un aumento de 10% sobre la proyección base de 2030. Un análisis aparte de las organizaciones Earthjustice y Better Data Center Project estima que hasta cuatro quintas partes de la energía de los proyectos autónomos podrían salir del gas natural.
Una estimación mucho mayor que hace 18 meses
Fisher explicó que hace un año y medio el Sierra Club habría calculado un impacto equivalente a entre un cuarto y la mitad del actual. “Los números siguen desconcertándonos”, afirmó a Bloomberg. El análisis se apoya en documentos públicos y en proyecciones de otros grupos, entre ellos el recuento de plantas previstas que hizo la organización Environmental Integrity Project.
La cifra supera a las de otros trabajos. La organización Union of Concerned Scientists proyectó en enero que la electricidad fósil para centros de datos podría elevar entre 19% y 29% las emisiones del sector, hasta 342 millones de toneladas anuales en 2035. Un artículo de investigadores de Estados Unidos y Canadá, publicado en junio, calculó un alza de 28%.
Las emisiones netas de gases de efecto invernadero del país bajaron de unos 6.580 millones de toneladas métricas en 2007, su punto máximo, a unos 5.350 millones en 2025, según The Verge. Esa tendencia empezó a revertirse el año pasado, cuando la demanda de los centros de datos presionó sobre el consumo de electricidad.
Un pronóstico con mucha incertidumbre
El propio Bloomberg advierte que el margen de error es amplio: la diferencia entre las estimaciones más bajas y las más altas de demanda eléctrica supera el consumo conjunto de California y Florida. El resultado depende de cuántos centros de datos se construyan, de qué tecnología usen y de cuánta capacidad renovable entre en servicio.
Brendan Pierpont, director de electricidad del centro de estudios Energy Innovation, dijo que existe el riesgo de que las emisiones sean suficientes para hacer retroceder años de avances. Precisó que no es un desenlace inevitable, porque dependen de factores como los retrasos en la entrega de turbinas de gas y las esperas para conectarse a la red.
Helen Kou, analista de BloombergNEF, señaló que un fuerte crecimiento del gas en las nuevas instalaciones llevaría a emisiones mayores. A su juicio, calcular con precisión cuántos proyectos de demanda se concretarán es “la gran pregunta del día”.
El análisis es interno y no figura completo en las fuentes consultadas. La contaminación del aire que generan esas plantas ya alimentó la oposición a los centros de datos en distintos puntos de Estados Unidos, según Bloomberg.

articles.title: La FIA mise à fond sur l'IA d'Amazon pour imaginer la F1 de demain
articles.text:
La FIA a officialisé, mercredi, un partenariat mondial avec Amazon Web Services. Le géant du cloud mettra son intelligence artificielle au service des règlements des futures Formule 1, mais aussi de la pratique amateur.
Déjà partenaires de longue date sur la data notamment, la Fédération automobile internationale (FIA) et Amazon Web Services (AWS) ont annoncé, mercredi, avoir scellé une nouvelle union, plus globale encore, sur l'intelligence artificielle, le cloud, le machine learning et l'infrastructure cloud. Le groupe américain devient le partenaire officiel de l'instance sur toutes ces composantes. Le géant du cloud connaissait déjà bien les paddocks, mais le voilà désormais officiellement associé à ceux qui écrivent les règles. Qu'il s'agisse des souffleries virtuelles, des ingénieurs épaulés par l'IA ou des licences dématérialisées, l'accord va de la F1 aux courses de club, pour concerner autant la monoplace de demain que le pilote amateur du dimanche.
Pourquoi la FIA mise désormais sur l’IA et le cloud d’AWS pour la Formule 1
On sait que la FIA fait déjà tourner ses simulations aérodynamiques sur les capacités de calcul haute performance d'AWS. Le principe s'appelle d'ailleurs la simulation numérique des fluides. On découpe l'air qui entoure une monoplace en une multitude de petites cellules, puis on calcule comment chacune se comporte. Il n'y a ni pièce à fabriquer, ni maquette à souffler. Du coup, on innove plus vite, pour moins cher, avec un impact environnemental réduit. La directrice mondiale événements, sport et divertissement d'AWS, Kristin Shaff, rappelle que le sport automobile est l'un des environnements les plus exigeants et les plus riches en données au monde.
Pourquoi la FIA s'y intéresse-t-elle autant ? Tout simplement parce que c'est elle qui fixe le cadre technique dans lequel les écuries devront ensuite rivaliser d'ingéniosité. Avant d'imposer une contrainte à dix ou onze équipes, autant savoir comment l'air réagira autour de la voiture, quitte à faire chauffer les serveurs. AWS jouera ainsi un rôle déterminant dans l'élaboration des règles techniques de la prochaine génération de Formule 1.
L'accord concerne aussi les équipes techniques et d'ingénierie de la FIA, qui recevront des outils d'intelligence artificielle. L'objectif est de renforcer leur capacité à concevoir des règlements qui font progresser la sécurité, la performance et la durabilité. Le communiqué présente bien l'IA comme un outil mis entre les mains des ingénieurs, pas comme un législateur autonome.
Au-delà de la F1, l'IA d'AWS veut ouvrir les portes du sport auto
L'autre volet du partenariat fait moins de bruit qu'un V6 turbo hybride, mais il touche bien plus de monde. Il s'agit de la plateforme de licences numériques lancée l'an dernier par les deux partenaires. Elle simplifie les démarches des pilotes, officiels et bénévoles. Elle offre aussi aux autorités sportives nationales, l'équivalent de la FFSA en France, un outil unifié pour administrer et faire grandir leur discipline. La plateforme s'étend désormais à davantage de pays, en plus de devenir multilingue, de gérer les renouvellements de licence et de se connecter à la FIA University.
Cette hyper modernisation pourrait aider à doubler le nombre de pratiquants du sport automobile dans le monde, l'ambition assumée de la FIA. La fédération prévoit d'ajouter des outils de gestion d'événements pour les bénévoles et les officiels. D'autres applications et services internes basculeront vers AWS dans les années à venir. Le chantier figurait en tout cas parmi les engagements de campagne de Mohammed Ben Sulayem, son président. Ce dernier a conscience que la technologie transforme chaque facette du sport, et la fédération doit mener ce changement. Le dirigeant compte aussi sur ce partenariat pour aider les clubs membres à travailler plus efficacement. L'instance réunit déjà 246 organisations membres sur cinq continents et encadre six championnats du monde.
Mais attention toutefois : mieux vaut ne pas confondre les casquettes, et l'embrouille peut vite arriver. AWS accompagne déjà Formula 1, le détenteur des droits commerciaux, depuis 2018, notamment pour les statistiques affichées pendant les retransmissions. Ce nouveau contrat le place cette fois aux côtés de l'arbitre. AWS rejoint le programme de partenaires mondiaux de la FIA, où il retrouve notamment Rolex, DHL et Hankook. Il s'affichera aussi aux FIA Awards, la soirée annuelle qui célèbre les champions du monde. Enfin, il soutiendra la Sustainable Innovation Series, une plateforme d'événements tournée, comme son nom l'indique, vers l'innovation durable, et menée en étroite coopération avec les championnats du monde FIA.

articles.title: Instagram Tests 90-Minute Horizontal Videos, Takes Aim at YouTube Creators
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Instagram Tests 90-Minute Horizontal Videos, Takes Aim at YouTube Creators
Instagram is testing a new format called Features, which lets creators upload horizontal videos up to 90 minutes long. The test started on Monday with a small group of US creators, following an earlier trial in Brazil, and it's aimed squarely at podcasters, comedians, and other long-form creators who mostly publish on YouTube today. Instagram head Adam Mosseri and VP of Product Tessa Lyons announced it in a video. Plenty of creators already post Reels clips to promote full episodes hosted elsewhere, so Instagram now wants to host the full episode too. Reels can link straight to the full video, and Features will also be recommended on the Explore page.
While YouTube shares ad revenue with creators in its Partner Program, Instagram has no plans to do the same for Features, at least for now. An Instagram representative said the company is funding some creators directly, but that it's "too early to share a long-term monetization model." Lyons said established creators can bring their existing sponsorships and branded content along. Instagram already tried long-form video once with IGTV, which launched in 2018 and was shut down in 2022. This time, the TV seems to be a bigger part of the plan, as the Instagram for TV app, which debuted on Amazon Fire TV in December 2025, has now reached Apple TV in the US. There's no firm date for a wider rollout, and without a revenue share, it's hard to see many creators leaving YouTube anytime soon.

articles.title: “Mi mayor decepción con estudiantes de MBA es que siempre quieren hacer lo que estaba de moda hace 5 años”: Sam Altman, creador de ChatGPT
articles.text:
El director ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman, advirtió que la inteligencia artificial transformará de manera radical el mercado laboral que enfrenta la generación Z, aunque consideró que ese proceso abre una oportunidad inédita para los jóvenes dispuestos a abandonar las fórmulas tradicionales. Las declaraciones surgieron de una entrevista concedida la semana pasada a la Escuela de Negocios de la Universidad de Stanford.
“Es completamente cierto que una enorme cantidad de tareas que la gente realiza hoy serán hechas mejor, más barato y más rápido por la IA, de manera completamente distinta”, afirmó Altman durante el encuentro.
Un mercado laboral en plena transformación
El creador de ChatGPT sostuvo que “amplios sectores” de los empleos actuales quedarán enteramente en manos de la inteligencia artificial. Aclaró, sin embargo, que esa transformación no ocurrirá con la velocidad que muchos anticipan.
Pese a esa advertencia, Altman planteó que la disrupción tecnológica representa una ventana de oportunidad para quienes estén dispuestos a pensar en nuevos negocios construidos sobre la base de esta tecnología.
La crítica a los estudiantes de posgrado
En ese contexto, el empresario formuló un señalamiento directo hacia una parte del estudiantado de posgrados en negocios. “Mi mayor decepción con los estudiantes de MBA es que siempre quieren hacer lo que estaba de moda hace cinco años, en lugar de intentar algo nuevo”, expresó. “Creo que este es un gran momento para hacer algo nuevo”, agregó.
Para Altman, esa oportunidad no se limita a destacar dentro del mercado de trabajo. El directivo consideró que la inteligencia artificial podría habilitar la creación de empresas que resultaban difíciles, o directamente imposibles, de construir apenas unos años atrás. “Hay muchas compañías que pueden construirse sobre la tecnología que OpenAI puso a disposición del mundo, que serán mucho más grandes y, espero, más importantes que OpenAI”, sostuvo.
La experiencia de Altman como fundador
El propio Altman cuenta con antecedentes en la creación de empresas desde cero. En 2005 abandonó sus estudios de ciencias de la computación en Stanford para cofundar Loopt, una startup de redes sociales basada en geolocalización que luego fue adquirida por otra compañía. Posteriormente se incorporó a Y Combinator, la aceleradora de startups, donde ejerció como presidente entre 2014 y 2019.
Desde esa experiencia, el directivo planteó que la etapa actual constituye un momento propicio para que una nueva generación de emprendedores aborde problemas que antes parecían inalcanzables. “Si estás por salir al mundo ahora mismo para trabajar en algo, creo que quieres comenzar tu carrera en un momento del mayor cambio, cuando el terreno de juego está más abierto”, señaló ante los estudiantes de Stanford.
“Creo que las personas con alto potencial, impulso, ideas, una nueva forma de ver las cosas y nuevas habilidades tienden a desempeñarse relativamente bien cuando el terreno tiembla más”, agregó el ejecutivo.
La tendencia hacia el emprendimiento ya se refleja en los datos oficiales de Estados Unidos. En 2025, los estadounidenses presentaron 5,7 millones de solicitudes para iniciar nuevos negocios, la cifra anual más alta registrada en las dos décadas que la Oficina del Censo lleva relevando esta información.
Otras voces del sector tecnológico coinciden con el diagnóstico
El planteo de Altman encuentra eco en otros referentes del mundo empresarial y tecnológico. Alexis Ohanian, cofundador de Reddit, argumentó en declaraciones a Fortune el año pasado que los fundadores que construyen con inteligencia artificial desde el primer día cuentan con una ventaja frente a quienes intentan adaptar la tecnología a negocios ya existentes.
“Cualquiera que haya iniciado una empresa en los últimos dos años ha estado construyendo una compañía en la era de la IA, y eso les da una ventaja por defecto, porque el ADN de su organización está en este nuevo mundo”, dijo Ohanian al citado medio.
Por su parte, el empresario Mark Cuban, ex inversor del programa Shark Tank, instó a los emprendedores a tratar la inteligencia artificial como una ventaja competitiva y no como un recurso opcional. “Si no estás usando la IA para moverte más rápido o tomar decisiones más inteligentes, estás en desventaja”, declaró Cuban a Fortune en 2025.
“No es solo una herramienta, es apalancamiento”, añadió el empresario, quien remarcó que “el emprendedor más exitoso será el que entienda cómo usar correctamente la inteligencia artificial”.

articles.title: “Ne vous embêtez pas à mettre de l’argent de côté pour la retraite” dit Elon Musk, dont la fortune a dépassé les 1 000 milliards de dollars
articles.text:
“Ne vous embêtez pas à mettre de l’argent de côté pour la retraite” dit Elon Musk, dont la fortune a dépassé les 1 000 milliards de dollars
L’IA va rendre votre épargne inutile. C’est la promesse lancée jeudi sur X par Elon Musk, l’homme le plus riche du monde. Après un podcast en janvier et une interview à The Economist cet été, le patron de Tesla et de SpaceX enfonce le clou : face à l’abondance promise par la superintelligence, mettre de l’argent de côté pour ses vieux jours ne servirait plus à rien. Le conseil prend une saveur particulière venant d’un homme dont la fortune frôle les 1 000 milliards de dollars, et dont la fondation peine à distribuer ses propres fonds.
Jeudi 29 octobre, Elon Musk a répondu sur X à une internaute, @battleangelviv, qui s'amusait à justifier ses "décisions financières douteuses" par l'avènement d'un futur d'abondance. Le patron de Tesla et de SpaceX a surenchéri : selon lui, mettre de l'argent de côté pour un avenir lointain n'a plus aucun sens face à l'IA qui arrive. Sous son message, vu plus d'un million de fois, un internaute lui rétorque que seuls ceux qui ont de l'argent peuvent tenir ce discours. Un autre lui demande, perfide, pourquoi acheter des actions SpaceX dans ce cas.
	
Épargner pour un futur lointain ne sert à rien avec l'avènement de l'abondance superintelligente.
La sortie a déclenché une nouvelle salve de réactions outre-Atlantique. Business Insider a interrogé sept spécialistes de la finance personnelle et de l'IA, et tous recommandent de continuer à épargner pour la retraite, faute de garantie que le milliardaire voie juste.
Le même jour, nous racontions l'histoire d'un chercheur en IA qui a lui aussi cessé d'épargner pour sa retraite. Nate Soares, président du Machine Intelligence Research Institute, n'a plus alimenté son plan retraite depuis une décennie : il estime à plus de 50 % le risque que l'IA éteigne l'humanité d'ici dix ans. L'un craint l'extinction, l'autre promet l'abondance, et tous deux ont rangé la tirelire.
Saving money for the distant future is pointless with the advent of super intelligent abundance
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) October 29, 2026
Elon Musk et l'épargne : une prophétie martelée depuis un an
Le refrain n'a rien d'inédit. Le 17 décembre 2025 déjà, Musk répondait sur X à l'investisseur Ray Dalio, qui saluait le don de Michael et Susan Dell aux "Trump Accounts", ces comptes d'investissement ouverts pour les enfants américains. Un "joli geste", concédait-il, mais promis à l'inutilité : selon lui, la pauvreté disparaîtrait, l'épargne deviendrait superflue et un "revenu universel élevé" verrait le jour.
It is certainly a nice gesture of the Dells, but there will be no poverty in the future and so no need to save money. 
There will be universal high income.
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) December 17, 2025
Début janvier, il a enfoncé le clou au micro du podcast Moonshots de Peter Diamandis, cette fois en visant directement la retraite.
	
Ne vous embêtez pas à mettre de l'argent de côté pour la retraite dans 10 ou 20 ans. Ça n'aura aucune importance.
Il y glissait tout de même une condition de taille : il faut que ses prédictions sur l'IA, la robotique et l'énergie se réalisent.
En juillet, dans une interview fleuve accordée à Zanny Minton Beddoes, rédactrice en chef de The Economist, il a avancé un calendrier : l'IA dépasserait la somme de l'intelligence humaine d'ici cinq ans environ. Puis il a lâché, sans ciller, "L'argent n'aura plus d'importance en 2036".
Un conseil qui détonne en France, et une générosité très encadrée
Le message tombe à rebours des habitudes françaises. Selon l'Insee, les ménages ont mis de côté 17,2 % de leur revenu disponible brut au deuxième trimestre 2026, malgré un pouvoir d'achat en recul de 0,6 % par unité de consommation. Grosso modo, un euro sur six continue de filer vers l'épargne.
Ce bas de laine n'échappe pas pour autant à la frénésie de l'IA. D'après un rapport signé Matthew U. Scherer et Maya Jenkins, neuf géants de la tech cumulent 3 700 milliards de dollars de dette pour bâtir leurs infrastructures, et une partie de ces titres dort dans les ETF et les fonds de pension. Les assurances-vie et PEA des Français y sont exposés via les fonds indiciels, ce qui ramène au premier plan les risques financiers liés à la course à l'IA.
Le conseilleur, lui, ne manque de rien. Sa fortune joue au yo-yo autour des 1 000 milliards de dollars depuis l'entrée en Bourse de SpaceX en juin. D'après les estimations de Forbes, il a franchi cette barre dans les deux sens à plusieurs reprises, la dernière fois le 21 octobre, avant de redescendre à 922,9 milliards le 25.
Chez Musk, l'argent dort volontiers. Selon une enquête du New York Times, sa fondation a distribué 421 millions de dollars de moins que le minimum légal en 2023, troisième année consécutive de déficit. Il a en revanche versé plus de 276 millions de dollars depuis juillet pour sauver les majorités républicaines au Congrès lors des midterms, d'après l'Associated Press.
Le 19 octobre, il a aussi promis une action SpaceX à chacun des quelque 73 millions d'enfants américains en 2027, soit une dizaine de milliards de dollars. Sans préciser les modalités.
Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America.
This will be the first of many.
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) October 19, 2026
Le milliardaire réagissait à l'annonce d'Anthropic, la veille, d'engager 5 % de ses actions dans un fonds d'intérêt public, en lui recommandant de donner les titres "directement au public". À environ 150 dollars l'action, son cadeau représenterait quelque 1,2 % de sa fortune, selon ABC News.
	
Que vont vraiment apporter ces 150 dollars d'actions SpaceX à qui que ce soit ? Rien.
Reste une question que ses abonnés n'ont pas manqué de poser : si l'argent n'a plus d'avenir, pourquoi le premier de cordée continue-t-il d'en amasser autant ?

articles.title: AI firms want to build underwater data centers in the middle of an endangered whale habitat — but Alaskan campaigners have branded the plans 'really outrageous'
articles.text:
'We're deeply concerned': Underwater AI data centers proposed for Maine and Alaska — but critics say they could endanger whale species
The latest AI data center controversy is under the waves
- AI firm DeepGreen has suggested building data centers underwater
- This would help to keep the locations cool and running efficiently
- But the proposed locations could seriously harm endangered whale species
AI data centers need an awful lot of water to keep their machines running at optimal temperatures, and that creates a problem: just how do you get that much water on-site? One potential solution seems almost blindingly obvious: why not build them underwater? Yet as residents across the US are discovering, that idea is proving to be highly controversial.
Take the recently-pitched $100m underwater data center located off the coasts of Maine and Alaska, for example. AI firm DeepGreen Holdings has proposed building data centers off Western Passage, Maine, and Upper Cook Inlet, Alaska, and they would cover some 1,650 acres and comprise 66 compute pods and 300 tidal turbines.
The problem? Both locations are home to endangered whale populations that could be significantly impacted by the developments. In the case of the Maine site, the Gulf of Maine is linked to critical habits for the North Atlantic right whale. As for Upper Cook Inlet, that’s a designated critical habitat for the endangered Cook Inlet beluga whale.
Whales rely heavily on echolocation to aid their feeding, navigation and social activities. Construction of enormous data centers of this scale would produce sizable noise pollution that could adversely affect the whale populations, potentially threatening what are already endangered animals.
According to researchers (via Gadget Review), the heat produced by the data centers, meanwhile, could scare off the cold-water prey that the whales need to survive.
Putting whales at risk
As you might expect, these projects have not gone down well with researchers and the public. For instance, Cooper Freeman of the Alaska Center for Biological Diversity described the move as “just really outrageous.” Freeman added that “We’re deeply concerned about all the harms this project could bring,” adding that the proposal lacks an awareness of “how dangerous this is for the inlet.”
On Reddit, meanwhile, members of the public seem equally upset at the idea. One described it as “Evil. May these people be judged one day and punished for this level of absolutely evil. Disgusting.” Others were even skeptical that underwater data centers are even feasible in the long run, due to the hardware's longevity.

With AI data centers consuming untold amounts of energy and requiring significant cooling to keep everything humming along, it’s not surprising that some companies are looking to submerge their facilities beneath the waves as a remedy. But when that idea involves worsening the situation for endangered species, perhaps it’s time to find another solution.
