articles.title: Payer avec Google Wallet sans déverrouiller son téléphone ? Google prépare une option qui pose question
articles.text:
Google Wallet pourrait bientôt permettre de régler ses achats sans avoir à déverrouiller systématiquement son smartphone. Une nouveauté pratique en apparence, mais qui soulève quelques interrogations sur la sécurité des paiements sans contact.
Payer avec son téléphone est devenu un geste presque aussi banal que sortir sa carte bancaire. Il suffit de l’approcher du terminal, à condition toutefois d’avoir préalablement confirmé son identité. Une petite manipulation qui peut parfois agacer, notamment lorsqu’on doit déverrouiller une nouvelle fois son smartphone alors qu'on vient de l’utiliser. Google semble justement réfléchir à un moyen de supprimer cette étape pour les paiements du quotidien. Mais entre gagner quelques secondes à la caisse et protéger ses coordonnées bancaires, il faudra trouver le bon équilibre.
Google Wallet pourrait supprimer une étape avant le paiement
Selon une découverte d’Android Authority, Google travaille sur une nouvelle option permettant potentiellement de désactiver la vérification d’identité avant un paiement sans contact.
Les journalistes ont repéré cette fonction dans la version 26.42.1003171897 de Google Wallet, au sein des paramètres de vérification de l’application. Une nouvelle entrée baptisée « Tap to pay » apparaît aux côtés des réglages consacrés aux transports en commun.
Aujourd'hui, Google Wallet demande de confirmer son identité à l’aide d’un code PIN, d'un mot de passe, d'un schéma ou d’une méthode biométrique suffisamment sécurisée, comme l’empreinte digitale. Cette authentification reste valable quelques minutes, mais doit ensuite être renouvelée pour effectuer un nouveau paiement.
Il existe toutefois une exception : les utilisateurs peuvent déjà payer certains trajets en transports en commun sans déverrouiller leur téléphone, lorsque le réseau concerné prend en charge cette possibilité.
Google pourrait donc reprendre le même principe pour les achats ordinaires. En pratique, il deviendrait possible d’approcher son smartphone d'un terminal de paiement sans devoir systématiquement passer par le lecteur d’empreintes ou saisir son code.
Du moins, c’est ce que laisse envisager cette découverte. Car pour l’instant, la fonctionnalité n’est absolument pas opérationnelle. Android Authority a réussi à faire apparaître manuellement le nouveau réglage, mais une tentative d’ouverture provoque immédiatement le plantage de Google Wallet.
Impossible, dans ces conditions, de savoir précisément comment il fonctionnera.
Quelques secondes gagnées, mais à quel prix pour la sécurité ?
C’est évidemment la principale interrogation soulevée par cette nouveauté. Supprimer la vérification d’identité avant un achat pourrait faciliter les passages en caisse, mais également augmenter les risques en cas de perte ou de vol du smartphone. Une personne ayant accès à l’appareil pourrait théoriquement tenter d’effectuer des paiements sans connaître son code de déverrouillage.
Un scénario qui explique pourquoi Google a progressivement renforcé les mécanismes de vérification de Wallet ces dernières années.
Il serait toutefois prématuré d’affirmer que Google compte autoriser tous les paiements sans aucune protection. L’entreprise pourrait, par exemple, imposer des limites de montant, réserver cette souplesse à certaines transactions ou demander régulièrement une authentification. Aucune de ces mesures n’est confirmée à ce stade.
Autre inconnue : les pays concernés. Les règles relatives à l’authentification des paiements varient selon les marchés, notamment en Europe, et rien ne permet encore d'affirmer que cette éventuelle option sera disponible en France.
Surtout, Google n’a fait aucune annonce officielle. La présence d’une fonctionnalité dans le code d'une application révèle un développement en cours, pas nécessairement une nouveauté destinée à être commercialisée.
En attendant d’en savoir davantage, il faudra donc continuer à confirmer son identité avant de payer ses courses. Ce qui, finalement, n'est peut-être pas une si mauvaise contrainte lorsqu’il s’agit de son argent.

articles.title: Más de 2.000 millones de dólares salen de carteras vinculadas a Binance. La sospecha apunta a un hackeo histórico
articles.text:
Confiar nuestras criptomonedas a una plataforma de intercambio implica asumir que alguien será capaz de protegerlas las 24 horas del día. Es una responsabilidad enorme, especialmente cuando hablamos de empresas que custodian activos valorados en miles de millones de dólares. Por eso, cuando aparecen movimientos extraordinarios desde sus carteras surgen preguntas y la necesidad de encontrar respuestas en un breve periodo de tiempo.
Es precisamente la situación que rodea ahora a Binance, la mayor plataforma de intercambio de criptomonedas del mundo. Según The Information este 29 de octubre, un análisis de transacciones en blockchain detectó la salida de distintos criptoactivos valorados en más de 2.000 millones de dólares desde carteras asociadas a la compañía. Los movimientos han despertado sospechas de un posible ataque, y la empresa ha reconocido públicamente que sus equipos investigan los avisos sobre un problema de seguridad. Por el momento, no ha confirmado que haya sufrido un hackeo ni ha explicado el origen de esas transferencias.
Las estimaciones sobre el alcance del posible incidente difieren considerablemente. CoinDesk, citando datos de Arkham Intelligence, situó en más de 5.700 millones de dólares el valor de los activos atribuidos al presunto atacante, entre ellos bitcoin, ether y stablecoins. Por su parte, The Block documentó unos 3.550 millones de dólares recibidos por una cartera sin identificar, mientras que Conor Grogan, directivo de Coinbase, estimó que la cantidad potencialmente implicada podría alcanzar los 5.800 millones de dólares.
Binance ha trasladado un mensaje de tranquilidad mientras investiga: asegura que los fondos de sus usuarios están completamente seguros, aunque todavía no ha explicado qué originó los movimientos sospechosos. Changpeng Zhao, cofundador y antiguo CEO, fue algo más lejos al señalar que todo apunta a un hackeo, pero aclaró que ya no dirige la plataforma y que, como accionista, espera que los clientes queden completamente cubiertos. La compañía dispone además de SAFU, un fondo de emergencia valorado en unos 1.000 millones de dólares en febrero de 2026, cuya utilización no ha anunciado para este episodio y que tampoco garantiza automáticamente una compensación.
Una noche complicada para Binance y las criptomonedas
La reacción no se ha limitado al propio exchange. Paolo Ardoino, CEO de Tether, afirmó que la compañía había congelado más de 1.570 millones de dólares en USDT relacionados con el posible incidente, mientras que Jeremy Allaire, de Circle, comunicó el bloqueo de más de 800 millones en USDC, según explicó, en coordinación con las autoridades. Ambas empresas emiten stablecoins, criptomonedas diseñadas para mantener un valor estable, y pueden impedir que determinadas direcciones transfieran esos activos.
El rastro técnico ofrece indicios, pero todavía no una explicación definitiva. Un análisis de Odysseas, fundador de Phylax System, relaciona las operaciones de una cartera identificada como Binance 14 con EIP-7702, una funcionalidad de Ethereum que permite delegar la ejecución de código a un contrato inteligente mediante una autorización firmada. En determinadas condiciones, una autorización obtenida indebidamente podría permitir que un tercero ejecutara movimientos de fondos sin requerir nuevas firmas del propietario para cada operación. Lo que sigue sin aclararse es si alguien consiguió una clave privada, obtuvo una firma mediante engaño o utilizó otro procedimiento.
La incertidumbre sobre lo sucedido coincidió con nuevas caídas de las principales criptomonedas. CoinDesk situó el bitcoin alrededor de los 78.800 dólares y registró retrocesos en ether y BNB, aunque el mercado ya atravesaba una jornada negativa antes de que aparecieran las primeras informaciones sobre el posible ataque. Más allá de los precios, el episodio ha puesto el foco en otras empresas que mantienen relaciones financieras con la plataforma. Una de ellas es Ethena, que según The Information declaró una exposición no realizada de 8,8 millones de dólares a Binance y aseguró que los activos utilizados como garantía están custodiados por terceros fuera del exchange.
Para entender por qué se habla de un posible récord, conviene mirar los antecedentes. En febrero de 2025, Bybit sufrió el robo de aproximadamente 1.500 millones de dólares, un ataque que el FBI atribuyó a hackers norcoreanos. Pero hay otro caso que obliga a matizar la comparación: según Arkham Intelligence, en 2020 habrían sido sustraídos 127.426 bitcoins de carteras vinculadas al grupo minero LuBian, valorados entonces en unos 3.500 millones de dólares, un episodio que no fue reconocido públicamente por sus protagonistas. De confirmarse el incidente de Binance, su lugar en esa lista dependerá del importe finalmente acreditado y del criterio utilizado para comparar los distintos robos.

articles.title: Des automobilistes français ont trouvé la parade pour acheter des voitures électriques BYD ou Xiaomi pas chères jusqu'à 40 % sous leur tarif neuf en Chine
articles.text:
Des automobilistes français ont trouvé la parade pour acheter des voitures électriques BYD ou Xiaomi pas chères jusqu'à 40 % sous leur tarif neuf en Chine
Un peu partout en Europe, des automobilistes ont trouvé une parade pour s’offrir une voiture électrique chinoise moins coûteuse, jusqu’à 40 % sous leur tarif neuf en Chine. On parle d’une méthode qui peut s’appliquer partout en Europe, donc en France.
Et l’astuce des automobilistes, c’est de se tourner vers les voitures électriques d’occasion, avec environ 6 000 kilomètres au compteur. Et tout cela en évitant la taxe anti-subvention mise en place par l’Union européenne.
Des voitures qui échappent à la taxe anti-subvention
Rappelons que c’est en 2024 que l’Union européenne a ajouté une taxe anti-subvention aux 10 % de droits de douane. Selon le constructeur automobile, le total peut monter jusqu’à 45,3 % hors TVA. Sauf qu’il y a une faille, puisque cette surtaxe concerne les voitures électriques neuves.
Les voitures électriques d’occasion proposées avec plus de 6 000 kilomètres ne sont pas concernées par cette taxe en plus. Bref, une autre porte d’entrée pour les acheteurs européens qui cherchent à s’offrir un modèle venu de Chine en évitant les surcoûts.
De janvier à septembre 2026, les ventes de voitures électriques d’occasion de China EV Marketplace auprès de clients de l’Union européenne ont bondi de 280 % pour atteindre 7 900 exemplaires. Quant aux ventes de voitures neuves, elles ont chuté de 44 % sur la même période.
Désormais, le marché de l’occasion est la priorité européenne de China EV Marketplace, qui propose plus de 2 600 modèles de seconde main. On trouve aussi bien des véhicules électriques de BYD, Xiaomi, Denza ou encore Xpeng. Et la crise que traverse le marché chinois aide beaucoup puisqu’au milieu de cette guerre des prix, les constructeurs automobiles enchaînent les baisses sur le neuf, mais également sur le prix de l’occasion.
China EV Marketplace explique proposer régulièrement des voitures électriques avec environ 6 000 kilomètres au compteur à 40 % sous leur tarif neuf chinois. On parle là de véhicules récents et déjà décotés qui intéressent fortement les clients européens pour leurs prix attractifs en occasion.
En Allemagne, les données montrent que les voitures électriques chinoises d’occasion sont 24 % moins chères que les modèles européens équivalents. Après trois ans, leur prix se situe 42,9 % sous le niveau du neuf, contre 36,2 % pour les voitures électriques européennes.
Des voitures d'occasion dont le prix s'effondre vite
La Chine renouvelle ses modèles très rapidement et les baisses de prix du neuf font diminuer la valeur des générations précédentes. Les chiffres montrent aussi une décote brutale sur plusieurs modèles chinois. Une voiture électrique âgée de trois ans se revend en moyenne autour de 45 % de son prix en Chine. Pour la BYD Seagull et le Xpeng G6, c’est respectivement 50,5 % et 46,4 %.
Bien évidemment, l’astuce a ses limites puisqu’en France, le tarif affiché en Chine n’est pas le prix final. Il faut compter le transport, l’homologation européenne, les 10 % de droits de douane habituels et la TVA de 20 % qui s’ajoutent à la facture. L’astuce ne supprime donc pas toutes les taxes, mais celles qui concernent le neuf et permet donc de partir d’un prix chinois déjà très bas.
China EV Marketplace facilite aussi l’achat avec une prise en charge du transport, du dédouanement et de l’homologation pour l’Union européenne. La plateforme a également ouvert un point de livraison physique à Prague avec un premier stock de 20 modèles.
Grâce à cette implantation en Europe, les clients d’ici qui choisissent ces exemplaires éviteront les trois mois d’attente d’une importation directe depuis la Chine.

articles.title: GravaStar Introduces the Mercury Edge Series of Wireless Gaming Headsets
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
GravaStar Introduces the Mercury Edge Series of Wireless Gaming Headsets
GravaStar, the design-driven gaming hardware brand known for its sci-fi aesthetic, today announced the Mercury Edge Series. Led by Mercury Edge Pro, the lineup pairs GravaStar's distinctive design language with 53 mm dynamic drivers and spatial gaming audio. Mercury Edge adds versatile wireless connectivity and extended battery life, while Mercury Edge Lite offers a direct, battery-free USB-C experience.
Sculpted Design with a Distinct Gaming Identity
Inspired by skeletal architecture, the series combines flowing contours, polished transitions and layered earcup geometry with seven-color RGB lighting. Memory foam cushions, 90-degree rotating earcups and a sliding headband provide an adaptable over-ear fit.Mercury Edge Pro Brings Flagship Audio into Focus
Mercury Edge Pro is designed for players seeking greater spatial awareness, focused listening and multi-device control. THX Spatial Audio delivers virtual 7.1.4 surround sound on compatible Windows 11 PCs, helping players identify the position and movement of in-game audio.
Active Noise Cancellation reduces up to 34dB of environmental noise, while a detachable unidirectional microphone with ENC call noise reduction supports clearer team communication.
Simultaneous 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth audio mixing lets players hear low-latency game audio while staying connected to mobile calls or other Bluetooth audio.
An approximately 20 ms 2.4 GHz connection supports responsive gaming audio. Bluetooth 5.3 and USB-C complete the tri-mode setup. Its 53 mm dynamic drivers use CCAW voice coils, neodymium magnets and PU composite diaphragms for impactful, detailed sound, while compatible PC software provides EQ, THX, spatial audio and RGB controls.
Three Models for Three Ways to Play
Mercury Edge is built for wireless endurance and everyday versatility, combining 53 mm drivers, software-based virtual 7.1 surround, a detachable ENC microphone and 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3 and USB-C connectivity. Its 2000mAh battery supports extended wireless use, with EQ, surround and RGB settings available through compatible PC software.Mercury Edge Lite simplifies the experience with a battery-free USB-C connection. It retains 53 mm drivers, software-based virtual 7.1 surround, a detachable ENC microphone, adjustable comfort and seven-color RGB lighting for reliable plug-and-play gaming.
"Mercury Edge reflects how differently people play," said Yong Huang, Founder and CEO of GravaStar. "Edge Pro brings together our most advanced spatial audio, noise control and multi-device features, while Edge and Edge Lite offer clear choices based on connectivity, endurance and simplicity."
Pricing and AvailabilityThe Mercury Edge Series is available for pre-order beginning October 29, 2026 at gravastar.com:
- Mercury Edge Pro: $179.95 USD
- Mercury Edge: $139.95 USD
- Mercury Edge Lite: $99.95 USD
All three models initially launch in black, with additional colors planned for the future.

articles.title: Wabi reels in $55M for its consumer-focused AI assistant - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Wabi reels in $55M for its consumer-focused AI assistant
Wabi Inc., the developer of an artificial intelligence assistant for consumers, today announced that it has raised $55 million in funding.
IVP led the seed round with contributions from Amazon Alexa Fund, Andreessen Horowitz and Forerunner. They were joined by a group of angel investors that included Salesforce Inc. CEO Marc Benioff and Shopify Inc. CEO Tobi Lütke. Wabi is now valued at $1.25 billion.
San Francisco-based Wabi was launched last year by serial AI entrepreneur Eugenia Kuyda. She previously founded Replika Inc., another consumer AI startup that had more than 35 million users as of last November. Wabi disclosed today that it’s seeing “strong early demand” but didn’t share specific user base numbers.
The company’s service is accessible via Mac, iOS and Android clients. Its interface is built around a group chat tool with an embedded AI assistant. If a group of friends uses a chat session to organize a meet-up, the AI assistant can find nearby restaurants that could serve as a suitable venue. It customizes its suggestions based on conversation details such as the time at which the participants agreed to meet.
The assistant can also make use of information stored in other apps. An integration with Plaid, a financial data sharing platform, enables Wabi to generate personal budgets and flag unused subscriptions that the user should cancel. A Gmail connector powers an alerting feature that notifies consumers about important messages.
Wabi’s AI assistant doubles as a vibe coding tool. Users can create simple apps to automate tasks such as managing to-do lists and planning events. The AI is also capable of generating simple, two-dimensional games that run directly in the chat window.
The chat interface is flanked by a sidebar that contains widgets relevant to the conversation. If a user is planning a trip, Wabi might display flight departure and arrival dates. Restaurant recommendations appear in vertically organized cards that each contain a photo of a venue’s exterior and a brief description.
“We believe Wabi has the power to become an operating system for life, a place where your people, your tools, and your AI come together to help you do more of what matters,” Kuyda said.
If Wabi proves popular among consumers, large market players could decide to launch similar services. Such competition may require the startup to find additional ways of differentiating its software. Some vibe coding startups have trained custom AI models to set their tools apart from more popular alternatives such as OpenAI Group PBC’s Codex.
Wabi will invest the proceeds from its funding round in growth and product development initiatives. The company’s near-term priorities include the launch of a Windows app.

articles.title: Usar mais IA não significa trabalhar melhor, diz Amazon • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Usar mais IA não significa trabalhar melhor, diz Amazon
Companhia critica métricas baseadas em tokens e linhas de código para medir produtividade.
A Amazon está revendo como avalia o uso de inteligência artificial por seus engenheiros de software. Em uma nova orientação interna, a empresa afirma que quantidade de tokens consumidos, adoção de ferramentas e volume de alterações em código são métricas “profundamente falhas” quando usadas como metas.
A companhia não está abandonando a IA. A mudança é de foco: em vez de premiar quem usa mais ferramentas ou gera mais código, a Amazon quer avaliar o impacto do trabalho sobre clientes, negócios e equipes.
Um dos problemas é o chamado “tokenmaxxing”, expressão usada para descrever o consumo exagerado de tokens para elevar indicadores internos. Tokens são as unidades usadas pelos modelos para processar e gerar informações e também influenciam o custo de operação dessas ferramentas.
Segundo a Fortune, a Amazon alerta que transformar esse consumo em objetivo pode aumentar despesas sem necessariamente melhorar os resultados. O problema não é apenas teórico. Funcionários da companhia chegaram a executar agentes de IA em tarefas desnecessárias só para elevar seus números em um ranking interno descontinuado em maio.
Para o vice-presidente da Amazon, Terk Terkowitz, o melhor critério são os resultados obtidos no longo prazo. Isso inclui impacto para clientes, para o negócio e para as próprias equipes. Indicadores como consumo de tokens e adoção de ferramentas não serão descartados. A empresa afirma que eles ainda podem ajudar a identificar padrões, mas não devem funcionar só como metas de desempenho.
A orientação também vale no sentido contrário. Para Terkowitz, descobrir onde a IA não ajuda também é uma informação útil.
A companhia continua orientando engenheiros a aprender e incorporar IA ao trabalho diário e acredita que a tecnologia ficará no centro do desenvolvimento de software, combinada com conhecimento, experiência técnica e capacidade de avaliar quando determinada solução realmente faz sentido.
A discussão vai além da empresa. Um levantamento recente mostrou que apenas 3% das organizações superaram suas metas de economia com ganhos de produtividade por IA, mesmo com a maioria planejando ampliar os investimentos na tecnologia.

articles.title: Erling Haaland y Latin Mafia triunfan en los Instagram Rings 2026: estos son todos los ganadores
articles.text:
Instagram anunció a los ganadores de los premios Instagram Rings 2026, un reconocimiento destinado a creadores que se arriesgan con sus contenidos y generan conversaciones dentro y fuera de la plataforma.
Entre los nombres destacados de esta edición aparecen el delantero noruego Erling Haaland y el trío mexicano Latin Mafia.
Haaland, atacante del Manchester City, fue reconocido por trasladar a Instagram una personalidad que combina fútbol, humor y un estilo distintivo. Su presencia en la red social amplifica la figura que construyó a partir de su dominio goleador.
Latin Mafia, integrado por los hermanos Milton, Emilio y Mike de la Rosa, también forma parte de los ganadores. El grupo de Monterrey comparte en Instagram sesiones de estudio, momentos de gira y la dinámica creativa entre los tres músicos.
Los ganadores fueron seleccionados por un panel integrado por Donatella Versace, A$AP Rocky, Emily Adams Bode Aujla, FINNEAS, Chloé Zhao, Mikaela Shiffrin, OSGEMEOS, Adam Mosseri, Charm La’Donna, Eva Chen, Will Welch, Isamaya Ffrench, Vikas Khanna y Jack Edwards.
Quiénes son los ganadores de Instagram Rings 2026
Además de Haaland y Latin Mafia, la lista incluye a Salehe Bembury, diseñador estadounidense de calzado; Kareem Rahma, comediante egipcio-estadounidense creador del formato de entrevistas Subway Takes; y Renell Medrano, fotógrafa, directora y creativa multidisciplinaria nacida en Nueva York.
Asimismo, fueron distinguidos Skylar Marshai, fundadora de Sunday Creative Studios; Szilveszter Makó, fotógrafo especializado en retratos surrealistas; y Jordan Firstman, escritor, director, actor y comediante.
La nómina suma a Bhavitha Mandava, modelo india y embajadora de Chanel; Lyas, comentarista de moda radicado en París; Sam Visser, maquillador de Los Ángeles; y Pooja Tripathi, comediante, escritora y actriz detrás de la serie Brooklyn Coffee Shop.
Entre los reconocidos también figuran Under the Cover, una comunidad literaria británica; Muhammed Riswan, futbolista de estilo libre de Kerala, India, cuyas publicaciones acumularon 600 millones de reproducciones en Reels; y Steven Gao, cocinero y creador de contenido gastronómico.
Completan los ganadores MLMA, artista multimedia surcoreana; Ngozi Esther Edeme, maquilladora británica; Vicky Montanari, creadora de moda italo-brasileña; Jasmine “JB” Badie, directora creativa y coreógrafa; y la rapera londinense Little Simz, entre otros creadores de distintas disciplinas.
El reconocimiento a la creatividad y el riesgo
Instagram presentó Rings el año pasado como un premio para celebrar a quienes no temen experimentar con sus contenidos.
En su segunda edición, la iniciativa busca reconocer a una nueva generación de creadores por su creatividad y por la capacidad de impulsar conversaciones que influyen en la cultura dentro y fuera de la plataforma.
La compañía señaló que el premio no distingue un único formato de contenido, sino la búsqueda de ideas, la intuición, la exploración y la voluntad de asumir riesgos creativos. Según esa premisa, Rings reconoce a quienes convierten ese proceso en una forma de expresión propia.
El anillo diseñado para los ganadores
Cada ganador recibirá un anillo físico diseñado junto con Emily Adams Bode Aujla. La pieza de 2026 está inspirada en un trébol de cuatro hojas y fue tallada en mármol de Connemara.
El diseño parte de la idea de que los creadores reconocidos construyen su propia suerte mediante la intuición y la exploración. El trébol funciona como símbolo de ese recorrido creativo.
Con esta edición, Instagram volvió a poner el foco en las cuentas que utilizan la plataforma para desarrollar propuestas personales, construir comunidades y ampliar los límites de los formatos digitales.
Instagram añade videos largos al estilo de YouTube
Instagram comenzó a probar videos horizontales de hasta 90 minutos con Features, un formato dirigido a creadores seleccionados en Estados Unidos. La herramienta permite publicar contenidos más extensos que los Reels y busca captar a podcasters, comediantes y autores de vlogs.
Los usuarios podrán descubrir fragmentos breves en Reels y, desde allí, acceder al video completo sin salir de Instagram. La plataforma también evalúa llevar esos contenidos a pantallas de televisión.
El lanzamiento funciona como una prueba limitada y no tiene fecha confirmada para una disponibilidad general.

articles.title: T-Mobile's iPhone Duo deal has just been significantly improved — the device is now up to $1,200 off with a line or trade
articles.text:
T-Mobile's iPhone Duo deal has just gotten even better — the device is now up to $1,200 off with a line or trade
That's $200 better than previously
The iPhone Duo is still facing a lengthy backorder at T-Mobile, but that hasn't stopped the carrier from listing an extremely strong deal on Apple's first foldable.
Right now, you can get an increased discount of up to $1,200 with either a trade-in or a new line on the carrier's Experience Beyond plan. That's a $200 increase over the previous deal that we saw during the initial pre-order phase.
Annoyingly, you're still going to have to wait a while to get your device, even with this improved deal. In some cases, backorders reach all the way to January, so this is definitely a deal for those thinking long-term. Still, it's a very good promotion that's probably worth jumping on sooner rather than later.
Note, you'll need a line on the high-end Experience Beyond plan to be eligible for the biggest savings here, but you can still get an impressive discount of up to $930 with the mid-tier Experience More plan. This is another case where the savings have been bumped up, so even those looking for a slightly cheaper plan are well served here.
T-Mobile's opening iPhone Duo deal will end soon
Apple iPhone Duo: up to $1,200 off with a trade-in and new line at T-Mobile
T-Mobile has just surprised us with a brand new deal on the iPhone Duo, and impressively, it's even better than the one from the initial preorders phase. Right now, you can get a discount of up to $1,200 with either a trade-in or new line on the Experience Beyond plan. That's a whole $200 better than the previous deal, although note, there's still a considerable wait time for delivery, due to the device's popularity. 
What's new with the iPhone Duo?
The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foray into foldable phones. It features a 5.4-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner screen with a matte-like finish designed to minimise the appearance of the crease. Unlike rivals from Samsung and Google, its shorter, wider design resembles a passport or a foldable iPad mini, rather than the book-like design common on other foldable devices.
Under the hood, it packs Apple's new A20 Pro chipset and a titanium frame reinforced with ceramic fibres. Apple has also introduced exclusive software features, including new Liquid Glass animations, widescreen support for popular apps, and Apple Pencil compatibility for the first time on an iPhone.
In short, it's a very well-featured device. However, it does miss a few features like Face ID, a telephoto camera, and the Action button, all of which are available on the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Asus Vivobook 15 entra em oferta para quem trabalha com AutoCAD
Asus Vivobook 15 tem processador AMD Ryzen 7, tela Full HD e 16 GB de RAM; notebook para edição e projetos recebe desconto de 24% em oferta no Pix
O Vivobook 15 (modelo M1502YA) está saindo por R$ 4.041 no Pix na Amazon. O notebook da Asus voltado para edição de imagens e vídeos, com chip AMD Ryzen e 16 GB de RAM, recebe desconto de 24% sobre o preço original de R$ 5.499.
O Asus Vivobook 15 é um notebook adequado para AutoCAD, até certo ponto: seu chip AMD Ryzen 7 5825U de até 2 GHz e os 16 GB RAM DDR4 dão conta de projetos 2D e tarefas menos dependentes da GPU (que é integrada). Porém, quem trabalha com fluxos de modelagem e renderização 3D devem optar por um modelo superior.
Sua tela LED de 15,6″ de resolução Full HD (1.920 x 1.080 pixels) possui taxa de 60 Hz, brilho de 250 nits e película antirreflexo, para reprodução de imagens com qualidade. As dobradiças permitem que o laptop seja aberto em até 180º, para facilitar o compartilhamento de conteúdos em exibição com mais pessoas.
O SSD M.2 que acompanha o notebook possui 512 GB de armazenamento interno, mas pode ser substituído por um modelo de maior capacidade.
Um curioso recurso do Asus Vivobook S15 é sua cobertura antibacteriana: certas áreas de maior contato, como o teclado ABNT2 com teclado numérico, o botão Liga/Desliga, a área de descanso das mãos o touchpad, são tratados para inibir até 99% dos germes em um período de 24 horas, segundo a fabricante.
O laptop roda Windows 11 Home, mede 2 cm de espessura e pesa apenas 1,7 kg, sendo compacto e leve para caber na mochila e ser levado para qualquer lugar.
O notebook Asus Vivobook 15 modelo M1502YA (R$ 4.041 no Pix) possui conectividade Wi-Fi 5 e Bluetooth 4.1, e conta com uma porta USB-A 3.0, duas USB-C 3.0, uma USB-A 2.0, uma HDMI 1.4 e um conector P2 para fone de ouvido/headset, mas não possui entrada para cartões de memória.

articles.title: Biostar Introduces the EdgeComp MS-U320 Fanless Edge AI System
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Biostar Introduces the EdgeComp MS-U320 Fanless Edge AI System
BIOSTAR, a leading manufacturer of edge AI solution, IPC systems, motherboards, graphics cards, and storage devices, today introduced the EdgeComp MS-U320, a compact fanless edge AI system powered by the Intel Core 5 320 processor (Wildcat Lake). Designed for equipment manufacturers and system integrators, the MS-U320 combines on-site data processing, light AI computing, and industrial connectivity for applications in industrial automation, smart manufacturing, industrial IoT, smart retail, and smart infrastructure.
The MS-U320 features an onboard Intel Core 5 320 processor with six cores, clock speeds of up to 4.6 GHz, a 15 W TDP, and integrated Intel graphics. A single DDR5-6400 SO-DIMM slot supports up to 64 GB of memory, while the integrated CPU, GPU and NPU deliver up to 40 TOPS of AI performance. This combination supports local data processing and light AI workloads without requiring a separate accelerator.For industrial connectivity, the system provides four COM ports: two RS232 ports and two ports configurable for RS232, RS422, or RS485 communication. Dual 2.5GbE LAN ports, powered by Intel I226-LM and I226-V controllers, provide connections to industrial devices and networks. Two USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports and four USB 2.0 ports support peripheral connectivity. Onboard audio uses an ALC897 codec with an ALC105 amplifier with separate headphone and microphone jacks.
Display connectivity includes HDMI 2.1, supporting resolutions of up to 3840 × 2160 at 60 Hz, and DisplayPort 1.4, supporting resolutions of up to 4096 × 2160 at 60 Hz.
Three M.2 slots provide storage and wireless expansion options. The M.2 Key-M slot supports 2242/2280 NVMe SSDs through a PCIe 4.0 x2 interface. The M.2 Key-B slot supports 3042/3052 4G/5G modules via PCIe 4.0 x1 and USB 3.2, plus a SIM slot for cellular connectivity. The M.2 Key-E 2230 slot supports Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules via PCIe 4.0 x1 and USB 2.0.
Housed in a 167 × 135 × 60 mm chassis, the MS-U320 features a fanless design. Its wide-range 9-24 V DC input accommodates various power sources, and it includes a 90 W power adapter. The system supports operating temperatures from -20°C to 50°C and humidity levels from 5% to 90%. It is compatible with Windows 11 64-bit, Windows 11 IoT Enterprise 24H2, and Ubuntu 24.04. Optional DIN rail, wall mount, and VESA mount kits provide additional installation options.
The EdgeComp MS-U320 combines serial connectivity, high-speed networking, wireless expansion, and light edge AI processing in a compact, fanless platform, giving system integrators flexible deployment options for industrial and smart infrastructure projects.

Quoi de mieux pour fêter cette fête d'Halloween 2026 qu’une soirée marathon de films d’horreur, bien installé au chaud sous un plaid ? Mais si vous êtes abonné à Canal+, encore faut-il parvenir à faire le bon choix parmi les nombreux films proposés par la chaîne cryptée.

Quels sont les meilleurs films à voir sur Canal+ à Halloween ?
28 ans plus tard
Cela fait près de trente ans que le Virus de la Fureur s’est échappé d’un laboratoire d’armement biologique. Alors qu’un confinement très strict a été mis en place, certains ont trouvé le moyen de survivre parmi les personnes infectées. C’est ainsi qu’une communauté de rescapés s’est réfugiée sur une petite île seulement reliée au continent par une route, placée sous haute protection. Lorsque l’un des habitants de l’île est envoyé en mission sur le continent, il découvre que non seulement les infectés ont muté, mais que d’autres survivants aussi.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Évanouis
Lorsque tous les enfants d'une même classe, à l'exception d'un seul, se lèvent en pleine nuit à la même heure, quittent leur maison et disparaissent mystérieusement, les habitants d'une petite ville de Pennsylvanie décident d'enquêter afin de tenter de découvrir l'origine de ce phénomène inexpliqué...
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
The Mist
Tandis qu'une brume étrange semble envelopper une petite ville du Maine, David Drayton et son jeune fils Billy se retrouvent pris au piège dans un supermarché, en compagnie d'autres habitants terrorisés. David ne tarde pas à s'apercevoir que le brouillard est peuplé d'inquiétantes créatures... Leur seule chance à tous de s'en sortir consiste à s'unir.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Exit 8
Un homme piégé dans un couloir de métro cherche la sortie numéro 8. Pour la trouver, il faut traquer les anomalies. S’il en voit une, il fait demi-tour. S’il n’en voit aucune, il continue. Mais s’il se trompe, il est renvoyé à son point de départ. Parviendra-t-il à sortir de ce couloir sans fin ?
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
30 jours de nuit
Alaska, de nos jours. Au coeur de l'hiver, les habitants de la paisible ville de Barrow s'apprêtent à passer, comme tous les ans, un mois sans soleil. À la suite d'une série d'évènements étranges, Eben et Stella, les deux shérifs locaux, vont découvrir l'invraisemblable vérité. Un gang de vampires a investi la ville pour l'éradiquer de tous ses habitants. Eben, Stella et un petit groupe de survivants vont alors tenter de survivre jusqu'à l'aube...
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Silent Hill
De plus en plus souvent, la petite Sharon rêve d'une ville abandonnée, Silent Hill. Sa mère, Rose, décidée à comprendre l'étrange mal dont souffre son enfant, décide de l'accompagner sur place. Alors qu'elles pénètrent dans cet univers lugubre, Sharon disparaît. Rose se lance à sa poursuite, mais se rend vite compte que ce lieu étrange noyé dans le brouillard ne ressemble à rien de normal.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Together
Millie et Tim, un couple endurci par le temps et les tensions, quittent la ville pour la campagne en espérant raviver leur amour. Une randonnée les mène dans une grotte où un incident les entoure d’une force surnaturelle. Bientôt, leurs corps refusent de se séparer, comme dirigés par un désir physique incontrôlable.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :

Après la mort de leur père, Andy (Billy Barratt) et Piper (Sora Wong) sont placés chez Laura (Sally Hawkins), une mère d'accueil au passé trouble. Rapidement, des phénomènes inquiétants surviennent, liés à un rituel visant à ramener sa fille décédée.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Marche ou crève
Chaque année, « La Longue Marche » rassemble des dizaines d’adolescents forcés de marcher sans discontinuer. Si un concurrent ralentit trop ou s'il reçoit trois avertissements — et au-delà, l’exécution est immédiate. Ray Garraty, parmi les marcheurs cette édition, découvre très vite que ce n’est pas seulement un jeu : c’est une épreuve d’endurance psychologique et physique, filmée pour fasciner le public.

Carrie est une adolescente torturée, mal dans sa peau et totalement ignorante de l’étendue de son pouvoir de télékinésie. Mais lorsque les brimades de sa mère, véritable bigote psychotique, et de ses camarades de classe sadiques dépassent les bornes, Carrie va laisser éclater la plus terrible des vengeances. Grâce à ses pouvoirs, cette adolescente autrefois timide va déchaîner les enfers autour d’elle dans un tourbillon de feu et de sang.

How Vision and Connectivity Enable Autonomous Agriculture
Dates: Wednesday, November 11 and Wednesday, November 18
As autonomous farm equipment becomes increasingly sophisticated, engineers face new challenges in delivering the reliable vision and data connectivity needed for safe, efficient operation. From navigating vast fields to identifying obstacles and optimizing workflows, autonomous machines depend on high-quality camera systems that can transmit data over long distances while maintaining performance in demanding environments.
Join this webinarto explore how Gigabit Multimedia Serial Link (GMSL) technology helps enable the next generation of autonomous agricultural equipment. We’ll examine how GMSL supports long cable runs, high-resolution imaging, multi-camera architectures, and functional safety requirements, allowing designers to build robust vision systems that scale from today’s assisted operation platforms to tomorrow’s fully autonomous machines.
Attendees will gain insight into:
How GMSL technology delivers video, control, data, and power through a single cable infrastructure
Why long-reach connectivity and built-in error detection are critical for large agricultural machines
How multi-camera aggregation simplifies system design and enables comprehensive machine awareness
Key considerations for supporting functional safety in autonomous and driverless agricultural applications
Best practices for building scalable vision architectures for next-generation farm equipment

articles.title: Cet as de la bureautique avec l'AMD Ryzen 5 et 16 Go de RAM s'offre une jolie promotion de 36%
articles.text:
Le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 est un ordinateur confortable pour travailler avec ce grand écran de 15,6 pouces et son format compact pour faciliter son déplacement. En ce moment, vous pouvez le trouver sur Amazon pour moins de 700 euros.
Si vous cherchez un laptop pour vos déplacements professionnels qui mêle performances et prix abordable, rendez-vous sur Amazon où le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 est disponible avec une réduction de presque 250 euros. Pour ce prix, vous aurez entre vos mains une machine performante grâce à l’AMD Ryzen 5 et aux 16 Go de RAM.
Le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 passe de 899,99 euros à 659,99 euros sur Amazon
Pourquoi choisir le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 ?
- Un écran confortable : Le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 se présente avec une dalle Full HD de 15,6 pouces. Cette grande surface permettra d’avoir plusieurs fenêtres ouvertes côte à côte sans ralentissement grâce aux 16 Go de RAM.
- Taillé pour la bureautique : Ce laptop est équipé de l’AMD Ryzen 5. Pour lire vos mails ou éditer des documents, cela sera idéal. Retoucher des photos sera même possible.
- Pour son prix qui renforce son attractivité : En pleine inflation des composants pour PC, le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 possède un rapport qualité-prix très intéressant au vu de sa configuration
Une configuration parfaite pour la bureautique
Ce Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 est un ordinateur pensé pour les étudiants et les professionnels, des personnes qui sont souvent en déplacement. Il faut donc que cette machine puisse se glisser dans un sac à dos sans trop vous alourdir. Mission accomplie ici puisque l’appareil ne pèse que 1,6 kg pour une épaisseur inférieure à deux centimètres.
L'écran est aussi une réussite avec une dalle Full HD de 15,6 pouces. Un traitement antireflet est présent tout comme un filtre pour limiter la lumière bleue. Vous pourrez donc passer plusieurs heures devant cet ordinateur sans souffrir de maux de tête.
Sous le capot, Lenovo a offert à sa machine un AMD Ryzen 5 et 16 Go de RAM. Un duo efficace pour le multitâche puisqu’il sera possible de profiter de l’entièreté de cette dalle de 15,6 pouces pour avoir plusieurs fenêtres ouvertes côte à côte sans que l’ordinateur ne ralentisse.
Le meilleur rapport qualité-prix du moment ?
Actuellement, le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 coûte moins cher qu’un MacBook Neo. Un peu plus de cent euros séparent désormais les deux appareils. Outre le prix, la machine de Lenovo s’avère plus polyvalente que celle d’Apple. Sur le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, la retouche photo et le montage vidéo seront possibles même si vous souhaitez travailler sur plusieurs timelines, là où pêche le MacBook Neo.
Le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 s’offre aussi un espace de stockage confortable avec 512 Go.
On pourrait donc croire que la copie de ce laptop est parfaite. Cependant, la batterie est un point faible. Outre le chargeur qui n’est pas inclus, le laptop ne devrait tenir que sept heures avant de s’éteindre. Cela peut être insuffisant pour tenir une journée de cours ou de travail.
✅ Les points forts
- Un écran de 15,6 pouces équipé d'un antireflet
- L'AMD Ryzen 5 et 16 Go de RAM
- Un SSD confortable de 512 Go pour la bureautique
❌ Les limites
- Le chargeur n’est pas fourni comme c’est devenu trop souvent le cas
- Une autonomie moins endurante par rapport au reste du marché
Habituellement vendu pour 899,99 euros, le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 chute à 659,99 euros sur Amazon
Si la batterie était au niveau du reste, le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 posséderait le meilleur rapport qualité prix du moment sans trop de débat. Malheureusement, le fait de devoir prendre son chargeur pour partir l’esprit tranquille réduit la portabilité de ce laptop qui était pourtant excellent grâce à ce format compact.
Ce défaut n’est pas rédhibitoire pour autant et la machine trouvera sans doute son public, surtout après cette réduction d’Amazon.

articles.title: Muere Patrick Stewart a los 86 años, el inolvidable capitán Jean-Luc Picard de ‘Star Trek’
articles.text:
Patrick Stewart ha fallecido a los 86 años. El actor británico, cuya interpretación del capitán Jean-Luc Picard en 'Star Trek: La nueva generación' lo convirtió en una figura emblemática de la ciencia ficción, murió el miércoles 28 de octubre en Los Ángeles, según ha informado Associated Press. La noticia también ha sido comunicada a través de su página oficial de Facebook. Stewart, que alcanzó a nuevas generaciones de espectadores interpretando al profesor Charles Xavier en la saga 'X-Men', desarrolló una carrera que abarcó el teatro, la televisión y el cine.
Según ha explicado su portavoz, Kelly Bush Novak, Stewart padecía alzhéimer y demencia con cuerpos de Lewy, dos diagnósticos que no se habían hecho públicos hasta ahora. Su familia describió como breve y conmovedora la etapa en la que convivió con ambas enfermedades y explicó que murió al cuidado de su esposa, Sunny Ozell, rodeado del cariño de familiares y amigos. El comunicado también pide que, en lugar de enviar flores, quienes deseen rendirle homenaje realicen donaciones al fondo de investigación del alzhéimer de Johns Hopkins o a los recursos para cuidadores de la Alzheimer's Foundation of America.
La ciencia ficción fue la que terminó convirtiéndolo en un rostro conocido para millones de espectadores. En 1987 asumió el papel de Jean-Luc Picard en ‘Star Trek: La nueva generación’, una serie que se mantuvo siete años en antena, sumó 178 episodios y dio lugar a cuatro películas. El propio Stewart había contado que, cuando llegó a Hollywood para rodarla, le aseguraron que fracasaría. Ocurrió lo contrario: aquella interpretación, marcada por su formación shakespeariana, acabaría acompañándolo durante décadas, hasta su regreso al personaje en ‘Star Trek: Picard’.
Su carrera también quedó estrechamente ligada al cine de superhéroes gracias a ‘X-Men’, donde interpretó por primera vez al profesor Charles Xavier en el año 2000. Stewart dio vida al líder de los mutantes durante la trilogía original, estrenada entre 2000 y 2006, y continuó apareciendo en distintas entregas de la franquicia. Entre ellas destaca ‘Logan’ (2017), donde su personaje moría. Sin embargo, su recorrido no terminó ahí: regresó en ‘Doctor Strange en el multiverso de la locura’ (2022) y volvió a interpretar al profesor Xavier en ‘Avengers: Doomsday’, una película todavía pendiente de estreno.
Mucho antes de llegar a Hollywood, Patrick Stewart había construido una sólida carrera sobre los escenarios británicos. Creció en Mirfield, una localidad obrera de Yorkshire, y se acercó al teatro a los 12 años, cuando se unió a un grupo de aficionados. Después obtuvo una beca para estudiar en la Bristol Old Vic Theatre School y pasó 14 años en la Royal Shakespeare Company, donde interpretó numerosos personajes clásicos. Su trabajo en ‘Macbeth’ le valió su única nominación a los premios Tony, y en junio de 2010 fue nombrado caballero por Isabel II.
La noticia también ha provocado reacciones entre algunos de sus compañeros más conocidos. Hugh Jackman, con quien trabajó en las películas de ‘X-Men’, lo recordó en redes sociales como uno de los grandes del teatro y la pantalla, además de un amigo del que había aprendido mucho.
A esas palabras se sumó William Shatner, protagonista de la serie original de ‘Star Trek’, que lamentó su pérdida y destacó la inteligencia, la elegancia y el profundo sentido de la humanidad que aportaba a todo lo que hacía. Stewart deja una trayectoria que abarcó varias generaciones de espectadores, desde los escenarios de Shakespeare hasta dos de las franquicias más reconocibles del entretenimiento.

articles.title: No-code apps help HPE cut executive status meetings - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
HPE cuts executive status meetings with no-code apps built on monday.com
Enterprises are learning that no-code apps deliver the most value when the people closest to the work build them. As AI agents arrive inside work management platforms, the harder task is getting employees comfortable enough to use them without letting adoption spin out of control.
That shift is playing out at Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co., which runs workflows across the company on monday.com Ltd.’s AI work platform. One early tester turned a single IT ticketing build, assembled in 24 hours, into a companywide practice of teaching colleagues to build their own workflows, according to Kate Kenner (pictured), capability and community lead for strategic sourcing and planning at HPE.
“My thing is, I love building things, I do, but I want to enable them to build it,” Kenner said. “So a lot of times, I’ll sit with them and be like, well, I think you have the skills to build this because it’s such an easy product. It really doesn’t take a lot of uplift to learn it.”
Kenner spoke with Rebecca Knight at monday.com’s Elevate event, during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. They discussed how HPE scales no-code apps, how it governs AI use and how agents are taking on routine reporting. (* Disclosure below.)
Scaling no-code apps and AI with guardrails
Enthusiasm for AI isn’t the problem. Research from monday.com and Nielsen, cited by Knight, found that 72% of people work at companies that mandate or strongly encourage AI use, even as the processes around it lag. At HPE, admins pace the rollout by training users first and giving groups separate AI credit allotments, Kenner explained.
“It’s really tough. But you got to give enough allowance for people to be creative and to get their hands wet … But also not let them go wild, wild west on it,” she said.
HPE is also building vibe apps with monday vibe, monday.com’s no-code tool for creating custom applications. Kenner’s first one replaced the chore of pasting charts into slides with an executive dashboard that can still export to PowerPoint for leaders who want a deck.
“It’s a no-code solution that we pair with so many of our boards to build the dashboards we want,” she said. “In our corporate world, I will say everyone loves PowerPoint and it has been very hard to get off PowerPoint.”
The payoff showed up on the calendar. With live project status available anytime, executives cut back their review meetings, while a finalize button archives each month’s numbers as a system of record, according to Kenner.
“They knocked a whole bunch of the meetings off the calendar,” Kenner said. “Instead of weekly, now they’re monthly.”
Those no-code apps now pair with AI agents that take on the grunt work. Each week, an agent Kenner configured pulls attendance for her Monday livestream from Microsoft Corp.’s Teams, maps attendees by organization, region and manager, and flags anyone missing from HR records.
“I basically programmed it and every Monday I just hit run and she’ll go through all of it and she’ll come back with any of the things that may be flagged,” Kenner said.

articles.title: 'I think this is a great time to go do the new thing': OpenAI CEO Sam Altman thinks Gen Z entering the workforce should throw out the rulebook and do their own thing
articles.text:
'I think this is a great time to go do the new thing': OpenAI CEO Sam Altman thinks Gen Z entering the workforce should throw out the rulebook and do their own thing
Gen Z need to try something different to stand out versus AI, Altman says
- Sam Altman says Gen Z need to do something different in the AI age
- Thinking outside the box may be key to getting a job, OpenAI CEO says
- AI will start taking over many roles soon, Altman predicts
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has said he believes young people entering the workforce today should look to go beyond traditional ideas and try something different in order to stand out in today's AI-dominated world.
Speaking recently at Stanford’s Graduate School of Business, Altman said the disruption caused by AI in businesses everywhere may only just be getting started, and new workers should react to this uncertainty and see it as an opportunity.
“My chronic disappointment with MBA students is that they always want to go do the thing that was cool five years ago rather than try something new,” Altman said. “I think this is a great time to go do the new thing.”
Lack of engagement
Perhaps unsurprisingly, Altman was keen to play up the effects that AI skills and services could have in the modern world of work, noting that “wide swaths” of the jobs we currently know, will soon be entirely handled by AI.
“It’s totally true that huge numbers of tasks that people do today will be done better, cheaper, and faster by AI - and completely differently,” Altman said.
“If you’re heading into the world right now to work on something, I think you want to start your career at a time of the greatest change, when the playing field is most open."
“I think people with high potential, drive, ideas, a new way of looking at things, and new skills tend to do relatively well when the ground is shaking the most.”
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Altman himself started Loopt - a location-based social networking mobile app - in 2005 as a 19-year-old drop-out, before founding OpenAI as co-chair with Elon Musk in 2015
“There are many companies that can be built on top of the technology OpenAI has put out into the world that will be much bigger and, I hope, more important than OpenAI,” he said.
This isn't Altman's first thought about the future of working in the AI age, with the billionaire having laid out his opinions quite a few times in the past.
In May 2026, he hit out at claims the increasing global usage of AI technology worldwide will lead to a "jobs apocalypse", despite widespread reports of layoffs at major firms.
And in July 2026, Altman noted that he doesn't expect a change in society or working practices for quite some time, despite widespread promises that AI would boost our productivity and efficiency across the board.

articles.title: Subscription Sprawl: Auditing the Software Your Business Pays for but Never Opens - Tech Guide
articles.text:
Understanding Subscription Sprawl in Modern Businesses
In today’s fast-paced digital landscape, businesses increasingly rely on a wide array of software subscriptions to streamline operations, enhance productivity, and stay competitive. However, a growing challenge that many organisations face is subscription sprawl-the phenomenon where companies accumulate numerous software subscriptions that go underutilised or not used at all. This hidden inefficiency can significantly drain budgets and complicate IT management.
Subscription sprawl occurs when businesses continuously subscribe to multiple services without thoroughly assessing their actual usage or necessity. Over time, these unused or rarely accessed subscriptions accumulate, leading to wasted expenditures and operational clutter. According to a report by Flexera, 30% of enterprise software spend is wasted due to unused or underused subscriptions. This figure highlights the scale of the problem, emphasizing the urgent need for organisations to take action.
Recognising and addressing subscription sprawl is crucial for companies seeking to optimise their software investments. Engaging with an IT advisory team at Hardin can provide valuable insights into your current software landscape, helping identify redundant or unnecessary subscriptions and recommending strategic actions to improve cost efficiency. This partnership often brings expertise and tools that internal teams may lack, enabling a thorough and objective audit.
Why Subscription Sprawl Happens and Its Impact
Several factors contribute to subscription sprawl. One common cause is the lack of visibility into software usage across departments. As teams independently adopt tools to meet their specific needs, the organisation may lose track of overlapping or redundant subscriptions. This decentralised purchasing approach, often referred to as “shadow IT,” can lead to multiple subscriptions for similar functions, increasing costs unnecessarily.
Additionally, the ease of subscribing to cloud-based services without central approval can exacerbate the problem. The “freemium” models and low upfront costs of many SaaS products encourage teams to quickly onboard new tools, but without proper oversight, these subscriptions may linger unused after initial trials or projects conclude.
The financial implications of subscription sprawl are substantial. Gartner estimates that by 2024, organisations will waste approximately 40% of their SaaS spending due to inefficient management and lack of utilisation. This not only affects the bottom line but also impacts IT teams’ ability to manage software effectively and ensure security compliance, as unmanaged subscriptions may not receive necessary updates or support.
Furthermore, subscription sprawl complicates contract management and renewal processes. Without a clear understanding of which subscriptions are essential, companies may inadvertently renew unused licenses or miss opportunities to negotiate better terms. The administrative overhead also increases as finance and procurement teams struggle to maintain accurate records, leading to inefficiencies and potential audit risks.
Engaging with experts like HI-TEX in the IT industry can help businesses establish robust processes for managing subscriptions and ensuring that every software investment aligns with organisational goals. Such partnerships can streamline procurement, enhance visibility, and implement governance frameworks that prevent future sprawl.
Conducting a Comprehensive Software Audit
A software audit is the first step towards mitigating subscription sprawl. This process involves systematically reviewing all active subscriptions, assessing their usage, costs, and alignment with business objectives. Here’s how businesses can approach it:
- Inventory All Subscriptions
Create a comprehensive list of all software subscriptions, including those purchased departmentally or by individuals. This inventory should capture contract details, renewal dates, user counts, and costs. Gathering this data can be challenging without centralised records, but it is essential for a full picture.
- Assess Usage Data
Gather usage metrics to identify which subscriptions are actively used and which are dormant. Many SaaS providers offer dashboards or reports indicating user activity levels. Combining this data with employee feedback can help validate actual usage versus theoretical access.
- Evaluate Business Value
Determine the importance of each subscription to business operations. Some tools may be critical despite low usage, such as specialised software for niche functions, while others may be redundant or replaceable. Understanding the strategic value of each subscription ensures that decisions support broader organisational goals.
- Identify Overlaps and Redundancies
Look for subscriptions offering similar functionalities and consider consolidating them to reduce costs and simplify management. For example, multiple teams might subscribe to different project management tools that could be unified under a single platform.
- Engage Stakeholders
Consult with department heads and end-users to understand their needs and preferences, ensuring decisions are well-informed and accepted. This collaborative approach helps in identifying indispensable tools and building consensus for changes.
- Plan for Optimization
Based on audit findings, decide which subscriptions to retain, renegotiate, consolidate, or cancel. This plan should include timelines for contract renewals, potential cost savings, and any necessary transition support.
Statistics indicate that organisations who regularly audit their software subscriptions reduce unnecessary spend by up to 25%. This significant saving can be redirected towards strategic initiatives or innovation projects.
Implementing Best Practices to Control Subscription Sprawl
After completing an audit, businesses should adopt best practices to prevent subscription sprawl from recurring. These practices create sustainable control mechanisms and foster a culture of accountability around software procurement.
– Centralised Subscription Management
Implement a central system or designate a team responsible for approving and tracking all software subscriptions. This visibility reduces duplication and uncontrolled spending. A centralized repository or software asset management (SAM) tool can serve as a single source of truth for all software licenses and contracts.
– Regular Usage Reviews
Schedule periodic reviews of software usage and costs to detect and address underutilised subscriptions promptly. Quarterly or biannual assessments help maintain a lean portfolio and adapt to changing business needs.
– Clear Policies and Governance
Develop organisational policies outlining procedures for software procurement, approval, and renewal. Ensure all employees are aware of these guidelines to reduce rogue subscriptions and encourage responsible software use.
– Leverage Technology Solutions
Use subscription management platforms or IT asset management tools that can automate tracking and provide actionable insights. These technologies can alert managers to upcoming renewals, unused licenses, or overlapping tools, enabling proactive decision-making.
– Negotiate Flexible Contracts
Work with vendors to secure flexible subscription terms, such as adjustable user licenses or cancellation options, accommodating changing business needs. Flexibility reduces the risk of long-term commitments to underused software.
Partnering with dedicated IT support providers can help businesses implement these practices effectively, combining technical expertise with strategic oversight. Such partners often bring industry best practices and tools to streamline subscription governance.
The Strategic Value of Subscription Audits
Beyond cost savings, auditing software subscriptions fosters better strategic alignment between IT and business goals. By understanding the actual usage and impact of software tools, organisations can make informed decisions about technology investments that truly support productivity and innovation.
An optimised software portfolio also enhances security and compliance. Unused or forgotten subscriptions may not receive timely updates or monitoring, increasing vulnerability to cyber threats. Regular audits ensure that all software remains under active management and meets security standards, reducing risks associated with data breaches or non-compliance penalties.
Moreover, subscription sprawl complicates IT operations, and reducing it simplifies management, allowing teams to focus on value-added activities rather than administrative tasks related to managing a fragmented software environment. Streamlined software management improves agility, enabling faster adoption of new technologies aligned with business priorities.
Additionally, subscription audits can reveal opportunities for digital transformation. By identifying redundant tools and consolidating services, organisations can invest in more integrated platforms that enhance collaboration and data insights, driving competitive advantage.
Conclusion
Subscription sprawl presents a significant challenge for businesses striving to manage their technology investments efficiently. By conducting thorough software audits, implementing centralised management, and engaging expert partners like the , organisations can uncover hidden inefficiencies, reduce wasted expenditure, and align their software portfolio with strategic priorities.
With SaaS spending expected to grow exponentially-IDC predicts global SaaS spend will reach $208 billion by 2024-proactive subscription management is not just a cost-saving measure but a critical component of modern IT governance. Embracing these practices empowers businesses to maximise the value of their software investments and maintain agility in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
Ultimately, addressing subscription sprawl transforms software management from a reactive, fragmented process into a strategic asset that supports innovation, security, and sustainable growth.

articles.title: Un robot inspirado en serpientes busca transformar los estudios en el intestino delgado: cómo funciona
articles.text:
Un robot blando inspirado en el movimiento de las serpientes logró avanzar unos 2 metros por el intestino delgado de cerdos, tomar biopsias, capturar imágenes y administrar líquidos sin daños visibles en el tejido. El prototipo, desarrollado por investigadores del Instituto Tecnológico de Massachusetts (MIT) y el Centro Médico UT Southwestern, busca facilitar el acceso a una zona del aparato digestivo que hoy resulta compleja de examinar y tratar.
El dispositivo, denominado BIOSENTER, fue presentado recientemente en la revista científica Science Robotics. Sus creadores consideran que, tras nuevas etapas de desarrollo y pruebas de seguridad, podría utilizarse para atender casos de sangrado gastrointestinal, enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal, obstrucciones, lesiones y tumores ubicados en el intestino delgado.
Este órgano mide cerca de 6 metros, tiene un diámetro aproximado de 2,5 centímetros y se encuentra plegado en una zona profunda del abdomen. Esa combinación dificulta que los médicos alcancen áreas donde pueden aparecer hemorragias, pólipos u otras alteraciones que requieren diagnóstico o intervención.
El procedimiento actual exige entrenamiento y puede prolongarse durante horas
En la actualidad, una de las principales alternativas para examinar el intestino delgado es la enteroscopia de doble balón. El método consiste en avanzar un tubo flexible mientras un profesional infla y desinfla dos balones de manera alternada para impulsar el instrumento por el tracto intestinal.
Aunque el sistema permite llegar a zonas inaccesibles para otros endoscopios, su manejo demanda capacitación especializada y las intervenciones pueden extenderse durante varias horas. Según Binbin Ying, profesor asistente de Ingeniería Biomédica y Medicina Interna en UT Southwestern y coautor principal del estudio, son pocos los gastroenterólogos preparados para realizar este procedimiento.
La nueva plataforma pretende reducir parte de esa complejidad mediante un movimiento automatizable y una estructura capaz de adaptarse a curvas estrechas. “Nuestro objetivo a largo plazo es desarrollar herramientas robóticas que ayuden a los médicos a examinar el intestino delgado de manera más segura y eficiente”, señaló Ying en un comunicado de UT Southwestern.
Un sistema de aire reproduce el avance alternado de una serpiente
El robot tiene forma de cilindro hueco y mide algo más de 9 centímetros. Su cuerpo incorpora cuatro cámaras inflables reforzadas con fibras de Kevlar. Al regular la entrada de aire en cada una de ellas, los operadores pueden alargarlo o doblarlo hacia distintos lados, una mecánica similar a la contracción alternada de los músculos de una serpiente.
Un controlador externo permite dirigir el equipo con una palanca de mando. El dispositivo permanece conectado al exterior mediante un cable, por el que circulan las señales de control y los elementos necesarios para su funcionamiento. En el futuro, podría ingresar al organismo por la boca o por el recto, según la región intestinal que deba evaluarse.
El diseño también incorpora dos zonas expansibles, una en la cabeza y otra en la cola. Estas partes se inflan por turnos para sujetar el robot a la mucosa intestinal y empujarlo hacia adelante. El mecanismo busca evitar la distensión excesiva de un tejido considerado delicado.
Las estructuras de kirigami dan agarre sobre la mucosa intestinal
Para resolver el problema de la superficie resbaladiza del intestino, el equipo cubrió las secciones de anclaje con fundas inspiradas en el kirigami, una técnica japonesa que combina cortes y pliegues para formar estructuras tridimensionales.
Las cubiertas permanecen planas cuando el robot está contraído. Sin embargo, al expandirse los balones de aire, surgen pequeñas puntas tridimensionales que se comportan como escamas. Esa textura aumenta el contacto con la pared intestinal y permite que el equipo avance con menor expansión radial que un balón convencional.
Las pruebas indicaron que estas fundas alcanzaron una fuerza de anclaje cercana a 1,5 newtons sobre la mucosa. En estudios con tejido porcino, BIOSENTER avanzó por 2 metros de intestino delgado en unos 11 minutos, con fuerzas de empuje de entre 2,2 y 6,4 newtons.
Giovanni Traverso, profesor de Ingeniería Mecánica del MIT, gastroenterólogo del Brigham and Women’s Hospital y autor principal del trabajo, explicó que el propósito es automatizar la evaluación de los cerca de 6 a 7,5 metros de intestino delgado que deben recorrerse en algunos diagnósticos.
El robot incorpora cámara, pinzas y un conducto para administrar líquidos
Además de desplazarse, el prototipo dispone de un canal central por el que pueden introducirse herramientas para procedimientos diagnósticos y terapéuticos. Durante los ensayos, los investigadores utilizaron una cámara para obtener imágenes en tiempo real, pinzas para tomar muestras de tejido y un sistema de pulverización de líquidos.
Las pruebas en animales mostraron que el robot pudo ejecutar esas tareas sin signos visibles de lesión o sobredistensión de los tejidos bajo las condiciones evaluadas. La administración de líquido se planteó como un modelo para futuros sistemas de entrega localizada de medicamentos.
Los investigadores trabajan ahora en mejorar la navegación y en incorporar herramientas de inteligencia artificial para optimizar la forma de las fundas de kirigami y el desplazamiento dentro del órgano. Antes de iniciar estudios en personas, el sistema deberá demostrar su seguridad en trayectos más largos, su facilidad de uso y sus resultados frente a la enteroscopia de doble balón.
Ying indicó que el siguiente paso será determinar si las capacidades robóticas de BIOSENTER pueden integrarse a instrumentos clínicos existentes y complementar los procedimientos endoscópicos actuales.

articles.title: Audio-Technica Introduces ATH-M50xSTS-WL StreamSet Wireless Headset
articles.text:
Thursday, October 29th 2026
Audio-Technica Introduces ATH-M50xSTS-WL StreamSet Wireless Headset
Audio-Technica today announced the release of its ATH-M50xSTS-WL StreamSet wireless streaming headset, the first wireless model in the StreamSet lineup. Designed for streamers, content creators, and gamers, the headset combines the studio sound of the ATH-M50x professional monitor headphones with microphone technology based on Audio-Technica's 20 Series. 
The ATH-M50xSTS-WL brings low-latency, interference-resistant 2.4 GHz digital wireless connectivity to the StreamSet range, expanding the lineup beyond its XLR and USB models. An included USB transceiver enables plug-and-play use with PCs and compatible gaming consoles, giving users the freedom of a cable-free streaming experience.The headset features a cardioid condenser microphone on a flexible boom arm for clear, detailed vocal reproduction. The boom arm positions the microphone close to the user's mouth to help reject background noise and flips up to quickly mute the microphone. Sidetone circuitry lets users hear their own voice in the headphones for a more natural, conversational experience. 
To further improve voice capture, the headset includes adaptive noise reduction with two selectable levels. The function continuously monitors audio input to prioritize the user's voice-over ambient sounds such as PC fans and air conditioners, and can be switched on or off at the earcup. 
The ATH-M50xSTS-WL uses the same 45 mm large-aperture drivers found in the ATH-M50x, with rare earth magnets and copper-clad aluminium wire voice coils. The drivers deliver exceptional clarity throughout an extended frequency range, with deep, accurate bass response. Two types of interchangeable earpads are included: standard M50x earpads that emphasize audio quality and sound isolation, and breathable mesh earpads for comfort during long streaming or gaming sessions. 
With up to 24 hours of continuous use on a full charge, the ATH-M50xSTS-WL supports all-day streaming. The included USB cable allows users to continue using the headset while charging and also supports optional wired audio operation. 
The ATH-M50xSTS-WL StreamSet will be available beginning October 28, 2026, at a U.S. Retail price of $299.

Teste avalia fibra da Vivo, Claro e Nio; veja o resultado
Vivo liderou quatro das cinco categorias em levantamento da Opensignal sobre internet fixa no Brasil.
A Opensignal liberou o seu mais recente relatório que avalia os serviços de internet fixa (fibra óptica) oferecidos pelas principais operadoras da modalidade no Brasil: Vivo, Claro e Nio (sucessora da Oi). O resultado mostra que a Vivo sai na frente no aspecto da taxa de download, enquanto a Nio foi a mais bem avaliada em qualidade.
O levantamento foi feito com base em medições realizadas em dispositivos de usuários de serviços da Opensignal entre 1º de julho e 28 de setembro de 2026.
Cinco aspectos foram avaliados: Confiabilidade, Qualidade Consistente, Velocidade de Download, Velocidade de Upload e Experiência de Vídeo.
As três operadoras apresentaram resultados satisfatórios, isto é, que atendem aos usuários no dia a dia. Mas a Vivo se sobressaiu em quatro das cinco categorias avaliadas, com destaque para o aspecto Velocidade de Download. Aqui, a média de cada companhia ficou assim:
A Vivo também levou a melhor no quesito Velocidade de Upload. As médias foram estas:
Na categoria Experiência de Vídeo, que considera parâmetros como qualidade da reprodução, tempo de carregamento e interrupções durante transmissões 1080p ou superior, a Vivo também saiu na frente, mas as operadoras rivais ficaram muito próximas:
No quesito Confiabilidade, deu Vivo de novo. Aqui, a Opensignal avalia a capacidade de uma conexão à internet ser estabelecida corretamente e permitir a conclusão de tarefas online em vários dispositivos de modo ininterrupto:
O “gol de honra” coube à Nio, que levou a melhor no aspecto Qualidade Consistente, que avalia a frequência com que a conexão oferece desempenho suficiente para a execução de tarefas comuns:
No resumo, ficou assim:
| Categoria | Vencedora | Resultado | 
|---|---|---|
| Velocidade de Download | Vivo | 142,8 Mb/s (vantagem de 25 Mb/s sobre a segunda colocada, a Claro) | 
| Velocidade de Upload | Vivo | 78,1 Mb/s (vantagem de 18 Mb/s sobre a segunda colocada, a Nio) | 
| Experiência de Vídeo | Vivo | Pontuação de 72,9 (de 0 a 100) | 
| Confiabilidade | Vivo | Pontuação de 595 (de 100 a 1.000) | 
| Qualidade Consistente | Nio | Proporção de 78,2% | 
Vale destacar, porém, que esse levantamento apresentou resultados gerais. Pode haver diferenças de acordo com a região geográfica. Não por acaso, a Opensignal deve apresentar um relatório sobre banda larga direcionado às dez principais cidades brasileiras já no próximo mês.

articles.title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES — company says it's taking Panther Lake capacity offline to build more Granite Rapids data center CPUs
articles.text:
Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES — company says it's taking Panther Lake capacity offline to build more Granite Rapids data center CPUs
Confirmation on a widely-speculated aspect of Nova Lake.
Intel's next-gen Nova Lake desktop processors will be the first client product to use Intel's enhanced 18A-P node, CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed in the company's Q3 2026 earnings call. The chief executive also said that the company intends to share more about Nova Lake at CES in January. The company's chief financial officer shared that Intel intends to take Panther Lake capacity offline to build more Granite Rapids data center CPUs.
"Nova Lake, our first Intel 18A-P client product, is tracking ahead of schedule, with design wins expecting to be twice those of Panther Lake at launch," Tan said in his prepared remarks. "We look forward to sharing more at CES in January."
There has been a lot of speculation about what node Intel's Nova Lake CPUs will use, with the rumor mill ping-ponging between Intel 18A and TSMC's N2P. Current speculation says the chip will use 18A-P for the SoC tile while using TSMC's N2P for the compute tile. It seems unlikely that Intel would use its most advanced node for an SoC tile, though it's possible.
Regardless, Nova Lake chips will use 18A-P in some regard. Intel announced in June that 18A-P had entered risk production, and at Hot Chips in August, Intel revealed its next-gen Xeon 7 Diamond Rapids will be the company's first server products to use the enhanced node.
Compared to 18A, which is available in Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake products currently, 18A-P comes with a 9% improvement in speed at iso-power, or an 18% reduction in power at iso-speed. Intel has described 18A-P as a drop-in replacement for 18A, allowing designs built for 18A to instead leverage 18A-P without any extra engineering work.
For 18A products, Intel says its new Wildcat Lake products that have shown up in devices like the Framework Laptop 12 are increasingly popular. "Demand for our Wildcat Lake is outstripping supply," said Tan. Intel says that 18A products now make up a third of client CPU revenue, up from less than 5% in Q1.
It makes sense that those products would be popular given the current environment. Tan said that Intel's OEM partners are "aggressively managing inventory to match softer sell-through," which means buying less to match the demand in the market. Intel's David Zinsner said the company expects the company's client business to decline by "more than 20%" in the next quarter."
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Zinsner warned of a further contraction in the PC market, describing a sustained decline in the size of the market over the next year, at least. "We expect the 2026 PC unit [Total Addressable Market] to decline approximately 12%, with second half units down more than 20%. We do not expect a sustained recovery until memory availability improves and pricing begins to normalize," Zinsner said. "For 2027, we're planning a PC unit TAM to decline roughly 10%."
Taking the comments together, Intel is saying that it expects the market itself to shrink significantly over the next year due to memory prices. It's not a situation of demand outstripping supply, at least not directly like the case of a component shortage. Rather, it's a pullback from direct customers, OEMs, and IT departments from spending, which is more significant.
Although Intel says the client PC market is shrinking, the company says that its long-term outlook remains positive. "We think next year, and in future years, we're a market-share-gain type of environment... we do think the PC is going to through a renaissance despite [memory shortage]," said Zinsner.
Despite the optimism, Zinsner said that Intel is taking some of its client capacity offline to build more data center products. In response to a question about reallocating wafers from client products, here's what the executive said: "Answer: Yes... What we're taking offline to put Intel 3 into Oregon is 18A wafers, which were generally going to build Panther Lake products, so we see the opportunity with some of that capacity freed up to go produce more data center wafers."
